tei:div.tei:p: "$ (389)༄༅// dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi ngo mtshar rin chen brgyud pa'i rnam thar la gsol ba 'debs pa u du m+ba ra'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(390)༄༅// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ rigs kun bdag nyid thog ma tha ma med// dngos gcig brtan g.yo kun khyab zung du 'jug /rang bzhin 'od gsal bde chen ye shes sku// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// spros pa kun bral stong nyid sangs rgyas pa// rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga gsang ba'i dbyings// chos 'byung thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du// gdod nas mngon byang chub la gsol ba 'debs// gnyis med g.yo ba med dang ris med dang*// 'dod dang mchog tu mi 'gyur 'dod chags che// dngos dang dngos po med pa zad pa dang*// ye shes dang ni sems dpa' kun tu bzang*// nyon mongs med dang nyon mongs chen po dang*// lhan skyes dpal ldan byang sems thig le 'dzin// dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje dang*// thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rnal 'byor mtshan// rnam grangs du mar ldan la gsol ba 'debs/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med mi 'gyur ba'i// bde ba chen po yod med mtha' bzhi las// rnam grol bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid// don dam ye shes sku la gsol ba 'debs// shes dang shes bya gcig gyur spros pa'i mtha'// (391)kun las rab 'das rgyu 'bras ma lus pa// ye shes gcig gis gcig car gzigs gyur pa// dpe bral chos kyi sku la= /stong nyid sgra brnyan shar ba'i nyin mor byed// nges pa lnga ldan sku dang zhing khams ni// snang la rang bzhin ma grub mkha' ltar khyab// longs spyod yongs su rdzogs la= /bzo skye mchog sogs dag dang ma dag pa'i// gzugs brnyan pad+ma 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan// sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// gang la gang 'dul ston la= /sna tshogs gzugs dang rnam pa thams cad gsung*// mi 'gyur bde ba rnam kun mchog ldan gyi// stong nyid zung 'jug gsang ba bsam mi khyab// mi zad rgyun gyi 'khor lor=

/rigs drug bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*// de nyid bcu drug rigs brgya mtha' yas rigs// gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad pa// rigs kun khyab bdag de la= /chos rnams kun la nye ring med par khyab// 'gro khams zad med rjes su 'dzin pa la// 'phel 'grib mi mnga' rtag par bzhugs nas su// rtsol med don chen sgrub la= /gzhi dus rang bzhin 'od gsal ngo bo nyid// lam dus zag med bde stong rnal 'byor gyis// bral 'bras dag (392)pa gnyis kyi mthar thug pa// spangs pa chen po de la gsol= /sgyu ma rmi lam pra phab brgyad bzhin tu// ji snyed shes bya rtogs bral ma 'khrul gzigs// chos can ji lta ba nyid mngon gyur pa'i// rtogs pa chen po de la= /nam mkha' ji srid 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ don rnams 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa yi// dmigs med thugs rje chad pa med par 'jug /sems dpa' chen po de la= /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' nyi zla dang*// rnam par shes pa sgrib bral dag pa yi// mtha' yas stobs dang nam yang skyon med sogs// yon tan brgyad ldan de la= /rtag pa dang ni mi gdung rab tu bsil// gcig pur 'gyur med bde ldan dri ma med// dga' dang rtag tu mnyam 'jog yid dang ba// ro myang brgyad dang ldan la= /bsam gyis mi khyab sku gsung thugs ldan cing*// rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas gnas skabs kun tu khyab// gnas gyur don sgrub byang chub skyed mdzad pa// dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan la= /longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde ba che// rang bzhin ma mchis snying rjes yongs su gang*// sku dang ye shes mi 'chad mi 'gogs pa'i// yan lag bdun dang ldan la= /gzugs phra reg pa yang zhing kun tu khyab// yang dag thob brnyes rab gsal brtan dang ldan// dbang phyug chen po 'dod rgur sgyur bar mdzad// khyad 'phags brgyad ldan de la= /rang bzhin med cing rang rig 'phel ba dang*// 'grib pa ma mchis rnam par mi rtog par// dngos po kun gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba yi// zab pa'i ye shes ldan la=

bsod nams ye shes de yi spyod yul snang*// chos kun la dmigs thams cad rnam pas 'jug /kun nas thams cad don spyod phrin las te// rgya che'i ye shes rdzogs la= /yul dang dus la nye ring ma mchis shing*// ngo bo dbyer med de nyid tha mi dad// chos kun mi rtog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pas// khyab pa'i ye shes brnyes la= /rgyun mi 'chad cing 'gog pa'i chos (393)mi mnga'// phra rab rdul dang 'gyur ba gtan nas spangs// rgyal sras kyis kyang bsam pa'i yul las 'das// rtag pa'i ye shes ldan la// kha sbyor sku dang 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// rnam pa snying rje rtog pa'i nye sbyor thim// rlung 'gag zhu bde mngon gyur byang chub sems// mi 'gyur bde ba rdzogs la= /stong nyid las skyes las snang sdug bsngal 'gogs// gar yang phyin cing g.yo med rlung sems gzugs// shes bya mi 'gal mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i sku// rang 'dra'i sprin phung 'phro la= /gnyis ka ma yin mi rtog chos kun gyi// rang bzhin la zhugs dag pa rab 'byams snang*// kun tu don mdzad go 'phang mi g.yo ba// zung 'jug yan lag rdzogs la= /ye shes gcig gis chos kun sgrib med gzigs// shes bya mnyam nyid ji snyed ma 'dres rtog /gdul bya 'dul mkhyen kun la rnam mi rtog /ye shes lnga dang ldan la= /stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi dang ma 'dres chos// bco brgyad skye la thugs rje chen po mnga'// zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig sogs// chos sku'i yon tan rdzogs la= /mtshan bzang so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cu dang*// gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu la sogs pa// gzhan don gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis po yi// yon tan 'byung gnas de la= /rtsol med lhun grub rgyun gyis rtag pa yis// 'gro kun lam stegs la 'gong lam du gzhug /nges legs mthar phyin mdzad pa'i phrin las ni// gang 'dul mkha' dang mnyam la gsol ba 'debs// bdag kyang srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas par// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dngos kun khyab pa'i bdag

/zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang myur 'grub nas// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rtag spyod shog ༈ /ye shes ḍā ki ni gu ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ye shes sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /rdo rje btsun mo rgyal ba kun gyi yum// smug nag rus pa'i rgyan (394)can mkha' la spyod// skal ldan rnams la mchog gi dngos grub ster// rje btsun ni gu ma la gsol ba 'debs// nyi ma gung pa'i byin rlabs las sprul pa'i// ngo mtshar sa gzhi k+sī ra yi ljongs// dzam+bu'i gling na dpe med rab grags pa'i// grong khyer mchog tu 'khrungs la= /rnam dag bram ze zhi ba'i go cha yi// rigs kyi thig ler na ro ta pa dang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro dral dang lcam mo'i tshul// nyi zla zung 'brel smin la= /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid kyi dngos// rgyal kun skyed pa'i gzugs su snang ba mo// srid pa'i tshul du rnam par 'khrul par yang*// sred len mtshams sbyor spangs la= /grangs med gong nas sa dang lam rnams kyi// pha rol son pas rten 'dir rang byung gi// grub pa'i rnam thar bsam mi khyab pa brnyes// lhan skyes mkha' 'gro ma la gsol= /sbyangs pa'i ngal ba ched du ma brten par// grub pa'i dbang phyug dag gi gsung sgros tsam// snyan la sims pas chos kun khong du tshud// rang grol bde ba che la= /rgyud dang gdams pa'i zab don phra mo yis// gcig shes kun grol mkhyen gnyis rtsal kha rgyas// chos nyid bden pa sgrib bral mngon sum gzigs// dpal ldan grub pa mo la= /stong pa'i mkha' la yid mig rlung bcings pas// dhū tir dpyid kyi sgrub byed gzugs mthong ste// du sogs rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan gcig char bskyed// bsnyen pa'i yan lag rdzogs la= /srog rtsol mun can lto bar 'gags shing 'babs// 'khor lo drug tu srog thur mnyam sbyor bas// 'byung ba drug gi nyi zla'i bgrod pa 'gags// nyer sgrub yan lag rdzogs la=

/rgya gsum las 'das dpe bral phyag rgya ches// mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes bde rang 'od kyi// rnam bcu'i sgyu lus dbang po thams cad pa// sgrub pa'i yan lag rdzogs la= /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung 'gags pas// de snyed mi 'gyur bde thob gtsug tor du// byang sems brtan las sa rnams yud kyis bgrod/ (395)sgrub chen yan lag rdzogs la= /nye rgyu'i spyod pas dgyes rgur rol mdzad pas// rdo rje 'chang gis rjes bzung dngos nyid dang*// skal pa mnyam yang slob pa'i zung 'jug skus// mkha' khyab 'gro don mdzad la= /chos rnams thams cad sgrib med mngon sum gyur// ting 'dzin sgo mo bye snyed bsam yas thob// rgyal kun gsang ba'i mdzod la rang dbang sgyur// rgyal ba kun yum khyed la= /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med bde chen sku// bde gshegs sprul pa thun mongs mchog gi bdag /sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal// rus pa'i rgyan can de la gsol ba 'debs// 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i ma rgan sems can rnams// gting mtha' med pa sdug bsngal rgya mtsho nas// zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i zhing khams su// dmigs med thugs rje chen pos drang du gsol/ lam zhugs skal ldan brtse bas rjes bzung la// 'gal rkyen gegs dang bar chad kun zhi zhing*// nyams dang rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba dang*// lam lnga sa bcu mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs/ ༈ /ye shes ḍā ki su kha sid+dhi la gsol ba 'debs pa bde chen sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /zag med lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ster ma// bcu drug lang tshos gang ba'i gzi mdangs can// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi tshogs rje mo// bde ba'i dngos grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// kha che'i yul du khyim bdag dbul po yi// tshul du bstan nas lam gyi rtogs pa spyod// dad dang snying rje chen po'i rtsal rdzogs pas// chags med sbyin par brtson la=

/bskal pa gaṅga'i bye snyed snga rol nas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen mthar phyin pa'i// sbyangs pa mngon gyur las 'phros dpa'i rkyen// khyim gyis thugs dbyung gyur la= /gsang chen 'byung gnas nub phyogs o rgyan yul// pho skyes dpa' bo mo skyes dpa' mo yi// 'du ba'i dbus su phebs pa tsam gyis ni// rigs kyi nus pa sad la= /ro ldan (396)chang tshong spyod pa'i sgyu thabs ston// 'bras chang nyis bsing rnal 'byor ma la bskur// a ba dhū ti nags khrod spyod pa dang*// dad pas nye mtshams sbyar la= /rje btsun bi rū pa yis rjes su bzung*// gsang sgrub bzhi rdzogs dbang bskur skad cig la// drug cu rtsa gcig lon pa'i rnam smin lus// bcu drug na tshod gyur la= /nang gi lam nas rdo rje'i sa chen rnams// yud tsam gcig la mngon tu bgrod mdzad nas// zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru bzhengs// mkha' spyod dbang phyug ma la= /lhan cig skyes dngos rdo rje bdag med mar// dngos su gyur nas 'khor ba ji srid bzhugs/ khams gsum 'gro la gzigs pa dus drug 'jug /bcom ldan 'das ma khyod la= /gsol ba 'debs la dngos su byin rlobs shing*// brgyud 'dzin bu rnams 'bral med thugs rjes bzung*// mchog thun dngos grub lo zla tsam gyis ster// thugs rje che mnga' khyod la= /shes rab phar phyin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// 'gro ba'i don tu gzugs kyi skur snang bas// bltabs mi ngoms na mdzes sku'i me tog ni// mtshan dpe'i ze'u 'bru chags la= /stong nyid rang bzhin chos sgo mtha' yas rnams// 'gro ba'i bsam pa ji bzhin ston pa'i gsung*// gzhom med sgra brnyan rnam pa thams cad pa// tshangs dbyangs drug cu ldan la= /bde stong dbyer med nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dngos// brtan g.yo kun khyab lhan skyes zag pa med// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i thugs mchog ni// chos kun 'byung gnas gyur la=

/bral smin yon tan bye ba'i bdag nyid can// bsam gyis mi khyab rnam par thar pa 'chang*// mtshan tsam thos pas zag med bde ster ma// yid bzhin nor mchog de la= /rgyal ba sems dpa' kun dang bde sbyor mdzad// 'byung bzhis gar khyab de snyed rnam par 'phrul// bum bzang nor bu dpag bsam shing bzhin tu// phrin las lhun gyis grub la= /thugs rje nye (397)ring mi mnga' kun la snyoms// skal pa ldan rnams mkha' spyod lam sna 'dren// byams pa'i bzhin ras snying rje'i 'dzum bag can// skye dgu'i gnyen gcig ma la gsol ba 'debs// brgyud 'dzin gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu rnams la// brtse ba'i zhal ston dgyes pa'i lung mchog stsol// rdo rje'i ye shes chen po'i dbang skur la// nyid dang dbye ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ ༈ /mnga' bdag mai tri pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa byams pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /che ba'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// snyan pa'i grags pas 'phags bod kun tu khyab// phyag rgya che brnyes jo bo mo tri pa// gnyis med rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bram ze'i rigs las mu stegs paṇ+ḍi ta// nā ro tā pa mjal te nang par gyur// dbang dang gdams ngag ci rigs gsan pa yis// sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad la= /na len+da ru bstan la rab tu byung*// rtsod dus kun mkhyen rin 'byung zhi ba sogs// mkhas grub mang bsten rtsod bral paṇa chen tu// grags pa'i ba dan bsgrengs la= /rnam gnon tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs// bshad sgrub spel mar mdzad tshe rgyal ba'i yum// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yis zhal gzigs shing*// lung bstan byin gyis brlabs la= /ting 'dzin grogs su 'gro ba'i dus mkhyen nas// nang gi kun spyod gsang zhing spyad pa la// glags lta'i snang ngor chang dang bud med dag /'o ma dril bur bsgyur la= /dge 'dun rnams kyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i tshe// chu bo gaṅgār lpags gdan bting nas bzhud// gzhan yang thun mongs thun mongs ma yin pa'i// nus pa dpag med brnyes la=

/da rung de kho na nyid ma rtogs pas// yi dam lung bzhin dpal gyi ri bo'i ngogs// rgyal bu sa ka ra dang lhan cig tu// grub brnyes bla ma tshol la= /ngal dub thang chad nyon mongs nyam thag kyang*// yid kyi re ba rdzogs bar ma gyur nas// zla (398)ba drug tu rtse gcig gsol btab pas// 'dod pa'i don grub gyur la= /btsun mo zung gis zhabs brten ri khrod mgon// mngon sum mjal nas zab mo'i brda' bstan cing*// dbang dang gdams pas rjes bzung gnas lugs don// 'chad par rjes su gnang la= /don dam ji bzhin gzigs pa'i ye shes skyes// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mtha' yas gtso bor gyur// dbus 'gyur 'chang du yid la mi byed pa// rgya cher 'chad cing spel la= /bsil ba tshal du grong 'jug rol rtsed sgyur// nag po chen pos bzhed pa mtha' dag sgrub// lta stangs grub cing sku lus sna tshogs sprul// bas mtha' nags khrod 'dzin la= /gaṅgā dha ri rat+na de bī dang*// slob dpon che bzhi la sogs rgya bod kyi// gdul bya skal ldan du ma smin mdzad nas// zag med dbyings su gshegs la= /bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog grub cing*// ye shes sku mchog mkha' khyab nyid du bzhugs// byang phyogs rgyud du snying po'i phrin las rgyun// thub bstan ji srid 'babs la= /mnga' bdag rgyal sras mai tri gup+ta yis// mos pa'i bu la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te// bsam gyis mi khyab lhan skyes phyag rgya che// gnyug ma'i de nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ ༈

/dpal rdo rje gdan pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa rang byung sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /nyi ma lta bu 'gro blo'i mun pa sel// zla ba lta bu mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// thub bstan mnga' bdag rdo rje gdan pa che// bsod nams 'byung gnas zhabs la= /stobs 'byor phul byung 'phags yul ma la bar// mi dge'i las dang ngang gis mi 'grogs shing*// gtsang sbra'i kun spyod lhur len bram ze'i khyim// byin rlabs dge mtshan shar la= /bstan pa'i dpal du bsam bzhin srid pa bzung*// rigs gzugs longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la// ma chags skye bas thob pa'i blo gros ni// don gnyis (399)bsgrub par phyogs la= /srid pa'i bde 'byor rmi lam ltar gzigs nas// nges 'byung blo shugs dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar// na lan+da ru bstan la rab tu byung*// legs pa'i don kun grub la= /sngon sbyangs stobs kyis rang bzhin nyes pa'i dri// gtan nas bral bas bcas pa'i ltung ba dang*// rmi lam du yang 'grogs par mi mdzad pa// don gyi dgra bcom chen por= /'phags yul shar nub dbus kyi paṇ+ḍi ta// grub ba rnal 'byor tshogs kyi thugs bcud bzhes// thos pa'i rgya mtshor rnam dpyod nor bus gtams// dgos dgu'i 'byung gnas gyur la= /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la 'gran zla bral// khyad par gsang sngags phyi nang chos tshul la// chags thogs kun spangs thams cad gzigs pa brnyes// mkhyen rab dbang phyug khyed la= /skal bzang bye bas pha phog thob gyur kyang*// gting mtha' mi mngon gdams ngag nor bu'i mdzod// mkhas grub klu dbang kun las bsdus pa bzhin// gzhan phyir 'dzin par mdzad la= /skal bzang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ma ga dhar// thub bstan 'dzin mdzad rig grol spobs pa can// rgyu skar dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin// tshogs kyi 'dren par gyur la= /snying po byang chub chen po'i seṅge'i khrir// 'jigs med chos kyi dbang phyug go 'phang brnyes// rgyal bas lung bstan rdo rje gdan pa zhes/

grags pas 'jig rten khyab la= /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bgrod gcig lam// byang chub thugs mchog lhun po ltar brtan cing*// bsil zer bzhin tu phyogs ris med khyab pas// rgyal sras thu bor gyur la= /rin chen rgya mtsho la sogs thun men dang*// thun mong gsang ba'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas// grub gnyis nor bu'i dpal la rang dbang sgyur// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khyed= /mnyam med byang chub sems kyi phrin las kyis// phyogs ris med pa'i gdul bya yongs su 'dul// bzhugs yul snod bcud (400)shin tu bkra shis mdzad// mthong thos dang pa'i sa la bkod pa yi// 'brel tshad don dang ldan la= /thub dbang rgyal sar thub pa'i mdzad pa skyong*// 'phags bod mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan// 'jig rten lha dang bcas pas phyag byas pa// mi yi seng ge khyed la gsol= /bdag kyang tshul gnas thos bsam sgom mthar son// byang chub sems 'byongs 'gro don phyogs med 'grub// thub pa'i bstan pa nyin mor byed nus pa// skyes mchog rnams kyi rnam thar myur 'grub shog/ ༈ /'jigs bral gyi slob dpon chen po ā bha yā kar gup+ta la gsol ba 'debs pa zhi ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ dzam+bu'i gling du nyi zla lta bur grags// rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad// rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa mchog /'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lho phyogs dza ri khaṇ+ḍar rgyal rigs su// sku 'khrungs gzhon nu'i dus nas sgra tshad dang*// rig byed yan lag dang bcas mur 'dug gi /rgyud gzhung pha rol son la= /skyed mos tshal du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mdzes ma'i gzugs kyis bskul te bhaṅga lar// byon nas mdo sngags kun la mkhas par sbyangs// sde snod 'dzin par gyur= /rab tu byung ste 'dul 'dzin slob dpon mdzad// dbang dang gdams ngag 'phags yul kun tu btsal// chos tshul kun dang khyad par sngags rgyud la// mkhyen rab shin tu rgyas der=

/dpal ldan sau'i pa yis rjes su bzung*// rdo rje phag mos 'chad rtsom mdzad par bskul// dur khrod kun tu bsgoms pas ting 'dzin brnyes// byang sems nus pa can= /rgyud nas bshad pa'i las tshogs rab 'byams dang*// bden stobs grub cing brtag pa'i rig pa yis// dbul po'i zab kyi 'og nas gter 'don sogs// ngo mtshar mtha' yas ston= /rdo rje gdan dang dpal gyi na len+d+ra// kra ma shī la rnams su mkhan po mdzad// chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor ba yis// rigs can gdul bya 'dul= /brgyad stong 'grel pa rtsom tshe phyogs bcu yi// (401)sangs rgyas rnams kyis mgrin gcig shes pa brjod// rdor phreng rtsom tshe me tog char chen phab// phag mo sku la zhugs der= /snye ma rtsom tshe thog mtha' bar gsum du// bde dgyes dus 'khor gsum gyis bkra shis stsal// de bzhin don ldan legs par bshad pa'i gter// bstan bcos mtha' yas brtsams la= /sras bcas rgyal ba rnams kyi dgongs zab don// phyi rabs 'gro la ngag lon bzhag pa bzhin// phyin chad bstan la 'byung bar dkar bas na// lung bstan don yod mdzad la= /nub phyogs yul du gtsug lag khang bzhengs tshe// lhung bzed nam mkhar bzed pa bza' btung gis// gang zhing mthun rkyen gnod gnas dbang pos sbyar// bzhed rgu bsam pas 'grub la= /theg chen pa rnams gtsug gi nor bu ste// nyan thos pas kyang 'dul 'dzin che zhes bsngags// rgyal ba'i bstan la dag ther chen mo mdzad// snyan grags phyogs bcur khyab la= /mkhyen rab thugs rje dbang phyug nus pa'i mthu// phun sum tshogs pas yongs rdzogs thub pa'i bstan// 'dzin skyong spel la dzaṃ gling rgyan rnams dang*// rnam thar mtshungs par gyur la= /dus skabs de yi rgya bod mkhas grub tshogs// slob mar gyur sogs mdzad pa mthar phyin nas// zhi ba'i gnas gshegs bar dor phyag rgya che// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes la gsol=

/gsol btab dge bas khyod 'dra'i bshes gnyen gyis// skye kun rjes bzung spangs rtogs nor bu'i mdzod// rang dbang spyod nas thub bstan rin po che// dar rgyas yun ring gnas pa'i byed por sho/ ༈ /grub chen rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra la gsol ba 'debs pa rin chen sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ tshogs gsum rin chen rdul mang brtsegs pa las// yon tan lhun po gling bzhi'i dbus na mtho// grub pa lha mchog bye bas bsten gyur pa// sgra gcan 'dzin sbas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'phags pa'i lho phyogs e la bhi sha'i yul// (402)rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sa gzhi khyad par can// grong khyer bhi ra dzi ru rgyal rigs ni// sā la lta bur 'khrungs la= /de tshe 'od dang sgra snyan dri bzang bcas// sprul pa'i lha bzhis ye shes snang ba bstan// ngo mtshar dge ba'i mtshan ma las brtsams te// de ba sa twar grags la= /dgung lo nyi shu'i bar du dam chos sbyangs// nyer gcig dus su rdo rje tsher ma yi// zug rngus gdung tshe rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang*// lha bzhis byin brlabs sngon gyi las ngan rnams// bsnyun gyis zad nas tshe 'dir mkha' spyod du// 'gro ba'i lung bstan thob la= /rang byung sgrol ma'i spyan sngar zhag lnga'i bar// smyung bar gnas tshe pha mas lcags su gcug /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yis legs bkrol nas// lung bstan byin gyis brlabs la= /rnam gnon tshul gyis bsngags pa'i gtsug lag tu// yongs rdzogs thub pa'i bslab gzhi legs par blangs// paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub thob du ma las// mdo rgyud rdzogs par gsan la= /zab mo sngags kyi don la mnyam gzhag tshe// bla mas a ba dhū ti'i spyod pa la// gnas par bskul yang mkhas pa'i bsnyems pa yis// re zhig bshol bas phyis su rtse gcig tu// bsgrubs kyang ma grub guṇa ā ka ra'i// bka' bzhin ljags dang yan lag spu gri yis// bcad pa'i mod la lha bzhis zhal gzigs shing*// sku lus sor chud gyur la=

/spyan ras gzigs dbang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rje btsun sgrol ma myur mdzad ye shes mgon// nam bzhed dus na dngos su chos gsung zhing*// byin rlabs dngos grub stsal la= /dzñā na sā ga ra yi bka' bzhin du// zhag bdun chur bying srin bu pad pa yis// sku yi khrag 'jib grong la nye ba yis// las sgrib rtsad nas zad la= /grub thob rnal 'byor rnams kyi bkas bskul te// rdzu 'phrul mthu yis gangs can ljongs su phebs// mkhas grub khyung po'i spyan sngar ya mtshan pa'i// cho 'phrul thog drangs byin rlabs lha bzhi (403)sogs// zab mo'i gdams ngag bka' dang lag len bcas// du ma stsal zhing sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du// skal ldan 'ga' zhig bcug nas 'phags yul du// yud kyis gshags bar mdzad la= /lho phyogs rab brtan rdo rje'i sa gzhi ru// g.yengs spangs sgrub pa'i sa sde btsugs pa yis// phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang*// 'chi med rig 'dzin brnyes la= /ri bo nag po zhes grags shīng gi ri'i// khong gseng nyid du 'ja' lus rdo rjer bzhugs// sbyangs pa'i mthar son ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs// bdag kyang sgrib gnyis dri ma kun zad nas// ye shes nyi ma khong nas shar ba yis// glo bur ma rig 'khrul ba'i mun khang bcom// rdo rje'i rig 'dzin tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig/ ༈ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs pa mos gus kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ dge legs kun 'byung thub pa'i bstan pa la// dus gsum 'gran zla bral ba'i mkhas grub che// mthar thug lnga ldan ngo mtshar sprul pa'i sku// khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gdod nas byang chub chen po mngon mdzad kyang*// thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad pas gdul bya'i ngor// rnam 'phrul mkha' dang chos dbyings khyab par ston// sku gsum yongs rdzogs khyed la=

/bod yul sa yi thig le dbu ru'i ljongs// snye mo'i gnas su sprul pa'i mtshan dpe nyid// gsal ba'i mod la grub thob a mo ghas// byin rlabs lung bstan mdzad la= /'di ni sprul pa'i sku ste rgya gar bgrod// paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub thob thams cad kyi// thugs bcud bsdus nas 'gro rnams smin grol byed// sna tshogs sprul pas gdul bya 'dul bar 'gyur// theg chen snying po mtha' bral chos sgra sgrogs// mthar thug gsang sngags bde stong dbyer med kyi// seng ge'i nga ro phyogs bcur sgrogs par 'gyur// de yi lus ni bde mchog 'khor lo ste/ (404)gsung ni ma hā mā ya'i bdag nyid 'gyur// thugs ni dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje ste// sprul pa'i gnas mchog gsang pa 'dus pa la// gsang gnas bde skyong gshin rje gshed du 'gyur// dkyil 'khor de rnams lus la bkod nas kyang*// gdul bya rnams la dngos su ston par byed// gzhan yang yi dam sna tshogs gzugs bzung nas// gdul dka'i skye bo dpag med 'dul bar byed// lo ni brgya dang lnga bcu 'tsho bar 'gyur// de yi mthar ni mdzad pa brtul ba'i tshe// ltas dang rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston par 'gyur// de nas zhing khams rnam dag bde ba can// rgyal ba kun bsngags zhing der sangs rgyas nas// theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur// phyi rabs dad ldan gdul bya thams cad kun// rgyal ba'i zhing der bgrod par the tshom med// de skad gsungs nas bla ma grub thob de// mkha' la bya bzhin gshegs la= /kun bzang rig snang 'od kyi rgyal po yis// byin rlabs ngo mtshar khyung chen gdung las grol// yig rtsis sems phyogs bon la mkhas shing grub// de 'dul gdul bya bskyangs la= /'byung gnas seng ge skor ni ru pa las// rdzogs chen sde gsum phyag chen gzhung gdams gsan// so so'i bstan la ston pa gnyis par gyur// skyes thob rtsal chen rdzogs la=

/sngon sbyangs stobs kyis 'phags pa'i yul du bgrod// rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas gnyis pa mjal// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs// yongs rdzogs thugs su chud la= /khyod ni sngon tshe rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i// nyan thos rdzu 'phrul che ste bdag la sogs// rgya gar mkhas pas mkhan po mi nus zhas// bsam yas yul du bsngags la= /gang gis lung bstan ji bzhin bsil ldan ljongs// snang ba mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul glang thang pas// tshangs spyod thar pa'i rgyal mtshan bslangs par mdzad// thub dbang gnyis par gyur la= /dkon pa'i rin chen gser phye (405)phongs med khyer// gces pa'i srog la ma bltas dka' spyad nas// rgya dang bal po'i yul du lan bdun byon// sems dpa' chen po khyod la= /rgya gar mkhas pa brgya dang lnga bcu bsten// khyad par mkhas shing grub thob lnga bcu dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma khyad 'phags rnam pa bzhi// longs sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la= /dngos su chos gsan ye shes mkha' 'gro gnyis// mnyes par mdzad nas mthar thug gdams ngag zhus// sgro 'dogs chod nas rtse gcig bsgrubs pa yis// mchog thun dngos grub brnyes la= /so sa gling chog seng ldeng nag gseb tu// rgyal yum rdo rje btsun mo ni gu mas// chig brgyud rdo rje 'chang gi gsang mdzod gtad// sa bcu'i dbang phyug gyur la= /bde sbyin sman gyi tshal du bdag med ma// su kha sid+dhis dbang bskur lung bstan cing*// gdams pa'i bdud rtsis thun min byin gyis brlabs// drug pa'i rgyal tshab gyur la= /gnyis med rdo rjes sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur lung nod mnga' bdag mai tri par// phyag rgya che dang mgon po'i gdams pa gsan// chos skyong bran du khol la= /rdo rje gdan du dus mchod chen mo mdzad// ngo mtshar mtshan ltas zhag bcu sprel mar byung*// lha mi mkhas grub kun gyis mgrin gcig bsngags// sa gsum 'gran zla bral la=

/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun// myur mdzad ye shes mgon por 'dus pa nyid// skye dang brgyud par bcas pa'i lha skal du// dngos su zhal bzhes phul la= /lha bzhis rjes bzung grub chen rā hu la// gdams ngag sgo skyel pheb nas rgyud sgrub thabs// man ngag las tshogs brjod las 'das pa gsan// ya mtshan rdzu 'phrul ston la= /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du mar dbang bskur mdzad// dgra bgegs g.yul ngo sprul pa'i dmag gis bzlog /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis dmigs pa'i sgrom bu gsungs// nad gdon dngos su 'don la (406)gshin rje'i pho nya lha yi bu mor sprul// rtag 'dzin can rnams skyo dang spro ba skyed// ri brag zang thal gcig dang du ma sogs// sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ston la= /bla ma ḍā ki'i lung bzhin shangs su phebs// zhang zhang thog drangs dgon gnas brgya rtsa btab// nyan bshad sgom sgrub sa ster khyab par mdzad// bstan pa'i sgron mer gyur la= /sku lus dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu la// gnas lnga rgyud sde lnga po dngos su grub// chos khri brgya rtsa brgyad du de snyed kyi// sprul pas chos ston mdzad la= /rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha yis gsol btab pas// zla bdun ting 'dzin zas kyi 'tsho ba bcas// tā la srid kyi nam mkhar skyil krung bzhugs// theg chen chos 'khor bskor la= /bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs lha tshims mi rnams grol// sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba byas so zhes// me tog char phab a la la yi sgras// lha rnams ched du brjod la= /bshad grwa chen mo'i phrag dog sprul pas gzhil// mu ge'i dus su snga dro thang chen la// sa bon btab pa phyi dro 'bras bur smin// skye dgu 'tsho bar mdzad la= /'og min bde ba can dang po ta lar// yum chen 'od dpag med mgon thugs rje ches// skye med rnam gsum tshe sgrub bdud rtsi bum// snying rje mkha' khyab stsal la=

/lcang lo can dang o rgyan gnas su pheb// gsang bdag rnal 'byor ma yis dbang bskur zhing*// gsang rgyud 'bar dang 'du ba'i gdams ngag gnang*// ting 'dzin 'dod rgur sgyur la= /thang lha sham po ma dros pa la sogs// mthu ldan che dgus srog gi snying po phul// dbang bskur dam btags bstan pa srung bar bskos// he ru ka dpal mtshog la= /slob ma dbus gtsang khams gsum sa gzhi la// rme'u ston dri med shes rab sdong po skyes// g.yor po rgya mo phan sems yal ga brkyangs// dngul ston rin dbang snying rje'i lo 'dab rgyas// la (407)stod dkon mkhar byams pa'i me tog bkra// zhang sgom chos seng 'od gsal snying po lci// rmog lcog sgyu lus rmi lam 'bras bu smin// bla ma ḍā kis lung bstan rang mnyam gyi// slob ma'i mthar thug drug gis gtsor mdzad pa'i// tshogs pa'i mthar thug khri phrag bco brgyad la// lo grangs du mar chos bstan smin mdzad nas// sku tshe'i mthar thug brgya dang lnga bcu'i mthar// rgyal chen sde bzhi dri za'i rgyal po sogs// 'jig rten che dgus mya ngan mi 'da' bar// gsol btab gyur la thugs rjes brtser dgongs nas// chos gsung lung bstan mdzad la= /'od dpag med pas bde chen zhing bkod bstan// khyod ni skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' ste// bde ba can du mngon par byang chub 'gyur// gang zhig khyod kyi rjes su slob pa dang*// 'od dpag med pa'i mtshan thos de dag kyang*// bde ba can tu rdzu 'phrul chen pos skye// brgyud 'dzin rnam gsum mngon dga' la sogs su// byang chub lung bstan thob la= /bdag gi bka' babs gdams ngag gnad 'di lta// gang na'ang med pas dbang po rab 'bring tha// rnam smin bag chags bar dor 'tshang rgya zhes// nges par zhal gyis bzhes la= /nga la dad rnams bde ba can zhing du// gsol ba thob dang der skye the tshom med// gsungs nas sku lus bkod pa du ma bstan// dbang bcu'i bdag nyid khyed la=

/rgyud sde lnga dang byin rlabs lha bzhi sogs// so so'i skur dngos bzhengs nas dam chos gsungs// 'ja' 'od rol mo'i sgra yis gnam sa gang*// me tog char chen babs la= /ngo mtshar ltas bcas bde ba can du gshegs// sku dang ring bsrel bkra shis 'khyil ba sogs// dad ldan 'dren phyir gdung rigs dpag med sprul// grol ba bzhi ldan khyod la= /bdun phrag gsum la ya mtshan ltas bzang sbrel// mthong grol sku 'bum (408)lha sku mkha' 'gro mas// dngos su mchod cing phyogs bzhir 'od zer shar// sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs la gsol ba 'debs// bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las// gsol 'debs chu thigs dad pas blangs pa'i mthus// bdag dang 'grel bcas rjes bzung byin rlobs nas// khyod kyi rnam thar tshe 'dir mngon byed shog /rje btsun khyung po bslu med skyabs kyi mchog /'gro kun spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan bzhugs la// thugs rje rgyun chad med pa'i bka' drin gyis// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ ༈

/mnyam med rmog lcogs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar gyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa rgyal ba'i sras// ye shes ḍā kis lung bstan rtsod med kyi// grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan rmog lcogs pa// rin chen brtson 'grus zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// shangs kyi lha phur she'u'i rigs su 'khrungs// chos sgor zhugs nas bla ma tshul bzhin bsten// sgro 'dogs chod nas nyams su bzhes pa yis// nges shes thag chod 'khrungs la= /thos pa snum dred khyer ba'i gang zag gis// rkyen byas gdams ngag tshol bar dam bcas te// khams pa a seng spyan sngar rgyud rgyal gyi// bskyed rdzogs zab mo gsan la= /bur sgom zhabs las rje btsun ras chung pa'i// bskyed rdzogs zhus nas sgrub la gzhol ba'i tshe// dgra la rtags bstan rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i// zhal gzigs ting 'dzin brnyes la= /dkon mkhar g.yor po rdo rje rgyal sogs las// phar phyin gtsor gyur gzhung gdams du ma gsan// khyad par grub chen khyung pos rjes su bzung*// mnyes pa dgu phrugs bsgrubs la= /gser gyi yon phul rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhi'i// gdams ngag lhag ma med par gnang nas kyang*// chig brgyud bka' babs rtag tu bla ma'i sku// rgyud sde'i lha ru gzigs la= /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin (409)mngon tu gyur// gcig shas kun grol mkhyen rab rtsal kha rgyas// gdug pa'i 'byung po mtha' dag brtul nas kyang*// 'gro mang bder bkod mdzad la= /mi 'khrugs pa dang ye shes ḍā ki gnyis// in+d+ra bo dhi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// khyad par he ru ka yi zhal gzigs shing*// zab rgyas dam chos gsan la= /mnyam med dwags po'i spyan sngar byon pa'i tshe// skye ba du ma'i bu gsungs dgyes brtser mdzad// gcer mthong chos sku rjen par ngo sprad pas// rtogs grol dus mnyam gyur la=/ phyag rgya chen po'i bka' babs brgyud pa gtad// ting 'dzin rtsal rdzogs de nas ji srid bar// tshe 'di'i rnam rtog skye bar ma myong gsungs// srid mtha'i byang sems khyod la gsol ba 'debs// rmog lcogs brag tu lo grangs bcu gnyis bar// mi zas spangs nas rtse gcig sgrub pa'i tshe// mi g.yo lha bzhi ye shes mgon po dang*// ḍā ki dngos su byon la gsol ba 'debs// shangs pa'i dus mchod mdzad tshe bla ma dang*// 'od dpag med byon dbu ma'i bdud rtsi gnang*// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas kyi// zhing khams mngon sum gzigs la=

/zad par zil gnon gzhan gyis mthong bar sprul// nam mkhar skyil krung bzhugs pas skal ldan rnams// dad cing rjes bzung gdul bya dpag med 'dus// kun kyang smin grol mdzad la= /mtshan dang gsung thos bzhugs gnas mjal ba dang*// dad cing mos pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin// rgyud la skyes nas grol ba tshad med byung*// 'brel tshad don ldan khyod la= /dbang bskur mdzad tshe sku yi gnas lnga dang*// rdul tshon dkyil 'khor rgyud sde lnga yi lhar// dngos su gyur ba skal ldan kun gyis mthong*// byin rlabs 'byung gnas khyod la= /bde ldan zhing nas rgyal ba'i rim gro pa// spyan 'dren pheb kyang zhal (410)bzhes ma gnang bar// lo gsum brtan bzhugs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// bu slob skyong bar mdzad la= /nga ni 'di nas shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing*// 'od 'phro can tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas// theg chen 'ba' zhig ston par 'gyur ro zhes// seng ge'i sgra chen bsgrags la= /brgyud 'dzin thams cad zhing der gsol ba thob// rnam dag zhing mchog de du skye'o gsungs// ngo mtshar cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa bstan// 'od 'phro'i zhing du gshegs la= /slar yang rdzu 'phrul 'od kyi lam la byon// brgyud pa'i dbang zhu 'gro ba'i mgon la bkon// shes rab ras par rigs brgyud mi 'chad pa'i// go sa gtad par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun rmog lcogs pa// gsol ba 'debs la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab pa dang*// 'od 'phro can gyi zhing du 'dren tu gsol/ ༈ /dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /byams pa'i sprin chen 'od gsal mkha' la 'khrigs// snying rje'i char rgyun gdul bya'i zhing sar 'bebs// grub gnyis 'bras bu smin mdzad skyer sgang pa// chos kyi seng ge'i zhabs la gsol ba=

'phags pa'i yul du shes rab go cha sogs// yongs su grags dang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa// du mar sprul nas gdul bya dpag med 'dul// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed la= /tsī na'i yul du log spyod chos la bkod// phra men spre'ur rang gi rigs mthun gyis// rgyu 'bras stong nyid snying rje'i chos bstan mdzad// gang 'dul sprul pa 'gyed la= /skye ba kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// rjes su bzung nas don gnyis lhun gyis grub// gangs ljongs 'dir yang sna tshogs sprul pa'i skus// 'phags pa'i phrin las bsgrubs la= /dbu rur 'gro ba'i mgon 'khrungs skyer sgang du// kun mkhyen 'bal las rang (411)byung mdo phyogs dang*// klu sbugs rnams su grub thob lce sgom las// 'phags pa'i smin grol gsan la= /mi lo phyed bzhir dka' spyad drag po yis// sgrub pa mdzad pas thugs rje chen po dang*// gshin rje gshed pos zhal bstan byin gyis brlabs// rtag tu 'bral ba med la= /tsha sgom sben phug pa las ras chung dang*// jo bo brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs par gsan// rkyen la brten nas rang sems chos kyi sku// skye med mngon sum rtogs la= /rje btsun rmog lcogs pa dang mjal ba'i tshe// ye shes mgon pos bsu zhing bran tu khol// chig brgyud bka' gtad snang ba'i bden 'dzin zhig /ting 'dzin rtsal chen rdzogs la= /spyan ras gzigs kyis dam chos rtag tu stsal// rgyud sde lnga yis man ngag zab don gnang*// grub thob ḍā ki du mas gdams pa dang*// rjes su bstan par mdzad la= /skyer sgang chos kyi gdan sar pheb pa'i tshe// ye shes mgon po'i 'khor rnams dngos su 'ong*// bla ma'i gdan sar mchod 'bul skyel pa yi// zhabs tog gus pas bsgrubs la= /mngon par shes pas ris med 'gro ba 'dul// wa ru ṇa yis klu yi nor bu phul// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa lan gsum gyis// bla ma mnyes pa bsgrubs la=

/o rgyan gnas su pad+ma thod phreng las// dbang chen rta mgrin dbang dang sgrub thabs gsan// pad+ma'i bka' bzhin snye mo zhu yas las// gdams ngag rdzogs par mdzad la= /ḍā ki sprin ltar 'du ba'i zhang sgom sogs// grub thob rnams kyi gdams pa'i zab bcud bzhes// ting 'dzin gzungs chu tsam gyis nyam thag pa'i// 'gro ba dpag med skyong la= /bcu gcig zhal gyi 'od zer 'phro 'du yis// rang gzhan nad gdon sgrib dag ting 'dzin skyes// dam pas zhi byed dgyes rdor yab yum gyis// dbyangs gsal bshags pa bstan la= /snyigs dus khyed kyis bstan pa'i sgrub lugs 'di// dar zhing zhal mthong brgyud mar 'byung (412)ngo zhes// thugs rje chen pos gdul bya 'dul bar bskul// 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam la= /'di nas bde can zhing du brdzus te 'khrungs// rgyal las chos gsan slar yang o rgyan tu// sngags kyi spyod pas rdo rje 'dzin gyi sar// 'gro mang bkod par mdzad la= /de nas mngon dga'i zhing du mi bskyod drung*// tshangs spyod mthar phyin baiḍūr+ya snang gi*// 'jig rten khams su mngon par sangs rgyas nas// brgyud 'dzin zhing der 'dren la= /de bzhin gshegs pa dri med nam mkha'i dpal// sku tshe lo stong 'dus pa 'bum phrag dgu// dam chos lnga khri drug stong gnas 'gyur zhes// mi 'jigs zhal gyis bzhes la= /kho bo mthong thos dran reg don dang ldan// gsol ba 'debs rnams shar phyogs dag pa'i zhing*// sar gnas sems dpa' 'ba' zhig 'gyur ces gsungs// chos dbyings snyoms par zhugs la gsol ba 'debs// spyan ras gzigs dngos dpon ston thugs rje can// bdag sogs las ngan gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams// thugs rje'i lcags kyus myur du bzung nas kyang*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ ༈ /sangs rgyas gnyan ston chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/

legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rab tu rdzogs// rdo rje 'chang dbang bshes gnyen gzugs su ston// sbas pa'i sangs rgyas gnyan ston ri gong pa// chos kyi shes rab zhabs la= /yol mdar sā la lta bu'i rigs su 'khrungs// rang byung ma bcos zhen bral blo dang ldan// lus dang longs spyod gang la'ang ma chags par// sbyin pa'i phar sbyin rdzogs la= /nges 'byung drag pos bstan la rab tu byung*// chos 'dul dbu tshad phar phyin mkhas par sbyangs// lhag pa'i bslab pa spyan gyi 'bras ltar bsrungs// tshul khrims phar phyin rdzogs la gsol= /nad gdon rkyen ngan dag la mi zhum par// dam chos phyir du dka' ba chen po spyad// gnod lan kun kyang (413)phan pas blan pa yi// bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs la= /thos pa'i sgron mes phyi yi sgro 'dogs bcad// bsam byung shes rab nan tan dpag med mdzad// yengs med bsgrubs pas 'bras bu mngon tu gyur// brtson 'grus phar phyin rdzogs la= /dbon ston thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung*// chig brgyud mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig rdzogs par gnang*// snang grags chos kun bden med 'ja' ltar gzigs// sgyu ma rang shar 'khrungs la= /dgyes rdor phag mo spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*// ār+ya tā res chos kyi bdud rtsi stsal// khyad par su kha sid+dhis ngo sprad pas// rtogs pa nam mkha' mnyam la= /ye shes mgon pos bka' bzhin phrin las sgrub// ba ru ṇa yis bran dang 'bangs su byas// snang srid lha 'dre che dgus dbang zhus te// de dag chos su bkod la= /nyin mtshan sgyu ma rmi lam lha yi sku// gang shar bde stong gnyis med ye shes dang*// 'dir snang 'khrul pa'i rtog pa yongs su nub// bsam gtan phar phyin rdzogs la= /dur khrod nag pa'i bka' bzhin la stod pa// 'phags pa'i yul nas rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis phebs// 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gsan pas gsang ba'i gegs// dbyings su grol bar bstan la=

/bla ma'i bka' bzhin ri gong dben gnas su// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor tshul gyis skal ldan rnams// rjes bzung phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing khams nyul// sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyed la gsol ba= /grub chen brgyad cu la sogs dngos su byon// zhag gsum bzhugs nas dbang dang dam chos gnang*// lung bstan gsung zhing mkha' la gya gyur gshegs// rgyal sras thu bo khyed la= /skye med dgongs pa mnyam rjes khor yug dang*// chos rnams ma 'dres chu zla lta bur gzigs// dbang thob mngon par shes pa drug po 'chad// shes rab phar phyin rdzogs la= (414)thog mda' bcu gsum sku la babs pa'i tshe// gnam lcags 'bar pa me tog rgyan bzhin gyur// ḍā ki'i sun ma bzlog nas rdo rje'i skur// byin rlabs gdul bya 'dul la gsol ba= /lha mo gnod sbyin dag gis bskul ba bzhin// bzo rgyu bsdogs tshe ye shes mgon po yi// sprul pas bzhengs nas de la dngos su thim// rang byon mgon po bskrun la= /rdo rje 'chang chen khyod la tshad med kyi// mos gus skyes pa de ni mngon 'tshang rgya// bdag kyang phyi bzhin byin gyis rlob po zhes// su khas mngon sum gsungs la= /khyed nyid gang gi mthong thos dran pas kyang*// de dag nam yang log par mi ltung zhing*// gdul bya'i sras su skye bar bla ma lhas// lung bstan yang yang mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// zhing 'di'i gdul bya re zhig rdzogs pa'i tshe// shar phyogs me tog bkram pa'i zhing du gshegs// rgyal ba pad+mo'i dpal du sangs rgyas nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor la gsol ba 'debs// 'jig rten mkhyen pa rgyal ba gnyan ston pas// sgrib med sangs rgyas spyan gyis 'dir gzigs la// las ngan lus ngan gnas ngan 'khyams pa yi// bdag sogs sems can smin grol mdzad du gsol/ ༈ /'gro mgon chos rje ston pa la gsol ba 'debs pa seng ge'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/

/yid bzhin nor bu lta bur dgos 'dod 'byung*// mtshan thos tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob// 'gro ba'i mgon po ston pa chos kyi rje// brtson 'grus seng ge'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ya ngal dkar po gshen bon grub pa'i brgyud// mkha' reg rtswa yi sil mar mtshan dpe gsal// spyod lam kun tu chos kyi snang ba mched// sngon sbyangs bag chags sad la gsol ba 'debs// dgung lo dgu par ma gcig sprul pa'i sku// (415)byon nas gcod kyi chos dbang sems la bskur// zhal gdams chig brgyud gnang zhing lung bstan mdzad// mkha' 'gro'i sras gcig gyur la= /'khor ba btson khang dmyal me'i 'o bltar gzigs// dgos med skyo shas drag pos rab tu byung*// yongs 'dzin du ma bsten nas mdo rgyud sbyangs// smra ba'i seng ger gyur la=/ grub thob bzang yul ba yi zhal snga nas// grub pa'i rgyal mos brgyud pa bdun pa ru// tshe dpag med sprul 'byung bar lung bstan par// ngos bzung chig brgyud gnang la= /sangs rgyas gnyan ston spyan sngar byon pa'i tshe// dpa' bo ḍā ki du mas bsu ba mdzad// chos 'brel thog ma lus gsum gdams ngag gnang*// bla ma sangs rgyas mthong la= /sgyu ma rmi lam sbyang sprul spel ba rnams// dus gcig grub nas ting 'dzin rtsal chen rdzogs// snang ba'i bden 'dzin mtha' dag hrul gyis 'jig /'khrul zhig chen po khyod la= /rdo rje 'chang nas rin chen brgyud pa yis// rim par lung bstan de dag gdul bya kun// khyed kyis 'dul zhes snyan brgyud gser chos bka'// yongs rdzogs skal ldan gyur la= /nyin mo blo 'das brjod bral phyag rgya che// mtshan snang mtshan nyid sum ldan lhun grub kyi// 'od gsal rang shar zung 'jug rang bzhin 'char// rgyal ba sku gsum rdzogs la= /sku la grib ma mi mnga' sems can gyi// bsam rgyud skye ba dus gsum sa ler mkhyen// dgongs pa gtad pas mdze gdon gcong nad sogs// mod la zhi bar mdzad der=

/dbang bskur dus su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis// dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing so so'i sku ru bstan// mtshan thos lam zhugs zhal mjal tsam gyis kyang*// ting 'dzin mchog skyed mdzad la= /bsam gtan brag tu mkha' 'gro ni gu mas// mu tig phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad gnang ste// sbas pa'i grub thob de mtshungs 'byung ba yi// lung bzhin smin (416)grol mdzad la= /bla ma'i bka' bzhin dbang po mchog dman dang*// bzang ngan rgan gzhon phyogs dang ris med par// nyams khrid thebs pas mtshan gyi snyan pa ni// rgya mtsho'i pha mthar khyab la= /dzam bu'i gling gi yul chen drug po dang*// gling phran tshun chad grub thob slob mas khyab// skal ldan 'bum phrag du ma smin mdzad pa'i// rnam thar bsam mi khyab la= /rigs drug khyab bdag yab yum lung bstan ltar// rin chen bdun ba'i phreng bar byon nas kyang*// rdo rje'i rgya bkrol thub bstan ji srid bar// thar pa'i kha lo bsgyur la= /rtag 'dzin can rnams longs med bskul ba'i slad// 'gro don mthar phyin 'ja' 'od me tog char// sa g.yo spos ngad bcas te shar phyogs zhing*// me tog bkram par gshegs la= /lha mi'i mchod pa'i rten tu ngo mtshar ba'i// gdung rigs lha sku ring bsrel dpag med sprul// srid mtha'i bar du dad ldan bsod nams zhing*// mi nyams rgyas par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// sa gsum 'gran zla bral ba chos kyi rje// dag pa'i zhing nas ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// gsol 'debs bu la thugs rje'i shugs bskyed la// tshe gcig mngon 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis rlobs/ ༈

/mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston la gsol ba 'debs pa dpal gyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ mtshan dpe'i me tog bslab gsum dri ngad 'phro// mkhyen brtse'i ze'u 'bru dri med mdzes pa'i sku// mthong thos dran pas gdung sel shangs ston pa// mkhas grub chos rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dal 'byor sdong po tshul khrims lo 'dab rgyas// thos bsam gzhi brtan ting 'dzin pad+mo 'dzum// nyams rtogs 'bras bu'i ro bcud g.yur du za// gtsang ma shangs ston zhabs la= /shangs kyi yul dang rwa rigs yab yum la// bkra shis dge ba'i ltas bcas sku 'khrungs nas// nges 'byung mos gus snying rje tshad med pas// byis pa'i spyod (417)las 'das la= /rnyogs pa med pa'i tshul khrims rgyal mtshan 'dzin// bslab pa phra mo dag kyang srog bzhin bsrung*// 'chad rtsod rtsom la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral// thos bsam rgya cher mdzad la= /longs spyod mtha' dag chos kyi phyogs su btang*// kyal ka'i phyir yang bla ma'i gsung mi gcog /tshe 'di'i 'dun gros thams cad lings kyis bor// rtse gcig sgrub par gzhol la= /ri gong chos rjes sangs rgyas ston pa'i zhal// mthong ba tsam gyis bcos min mos gus dang*// ting 'dzin mchog skyes bdun phrag zhag gi khongs// chos drug yon tan rdzogs la= /chig brgyud bdud rtsi thog mar gsol ba yi// skal ldan lung bstan 'khor gyi dang po zhes// 'gran zla bral ba'i thugs sras dam par mdzad// mkhas grub rtsod med gyur la= /'di dang phyi mar 'gro don dpag med 'byung*// bde ba can tu bcu bzhi'i sa thob cing*// brgyud 'dzin dang bcas dag pa mkha' spyod du// 'gro ba'i lung bstan brnyes la= /rdo rje phag mos dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod stsal// a ti'i khrid gsan lta stangs bcas ma thag /rig pa tshad pheb 'od gsal rgya 'byams shar// 'khrul snang dbyings su nub la= /gegs skyon mtha' dag bde ba chen por grol// phyi nang snang srid dag pa rab 'byams gzigs// sgrol mas byin brlabs mnyam rjes 'khor yug 'dres/

ḍā ki dngos su 'dul= /phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kun gsal bar mnga'// sku la 'bu srin dri med gzi mdangs ldan// zhal ras mthong ba tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur// thugs rje che dngos khyed la= /nad gdon mtha' dag zhal chab tsam gyis sel// mthong thos 'brel ba'i dad ldan ris med la// sgyu ma 'od gsal la sogs ting nge 'dzin// tshegs med 'char bar mdzad la= /yon tan ma lus sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs// bzhugs gdan na bza' phrugs gcig ma (418)gtogs pa// bdag gir bzung ba'i yo byad kun spangs la// zhen log mthar phyin khyed la= /'gro don rgya cher mdzad nas ḍā ki yi// bsu ba mkha' dbyings khyab sogs ngo mtshar ba'i// cho 'phrul bstan nas dag pa'i zhing du gshegs// sku gdud rgyas par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// bdag sogs 'khor ba'i 'dam las myur drangs te// tshe 'dir bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// phyi mar sku gsum go 'phang thob mdzad gsol/ ༈ /mkhas grub bsam sdings la gzhon nu grub la gsol ba 'debs pa snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /dri med rnam thar 'gyur med rtogs pa'i mchog /g.yel med thugs rje thogs med mngon par shes// don ldan phrin las bdag nyid bsam sdings pa// gzhon nu grub mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bsngags 'os yon tan brgya ldan nyang smad du// khyim bdag drwa mar mkha' 'gro'i lhums su zhugs// bltams nas dgung lo bzhi par grub pa'i gnas// gzigs tshe ting 'dzin brnyes la= /snar thang chos grwar mchims las rab tu byung*// mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag kun la sbyangs// btsun mkhas shes rab zab mo'i pha rol phyin// rnam spyod 'gran zla bral la= /'khor dang longs spyod tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor kun// mchil ma'i thal ba lta bur ring du bor// dka' thub drag pos dge sbyor dpag med mdzad// bya btang rgyal po khyed la=

/mtshan ldan mkhas grub brgyad cu rtsa gsum bsten// thugs yid gcig 'dres thugs bcud rdzogs par bzhes// kun gyis gzengs bstod lung bstan rjes gnang thob// rgyal tshab dbang brnyes gyur la= /sangs rgyas ston pa'i drung du pheb pa'i lam// gsol ba btab pas sgyu lus rmi lam gyi// ting 'dzin rang 'khrungs zhal ras mthong tsam gyis// rtog tshogs chos skur (419)grol la= /chig brgyud thog drangs zab chos ma lus pa// bum pa gang byor stsal te nga yis chos// bdag por 'phrod pas 'gro don mdzod cig ces// gnang ba lan gsum thob la= /bzod med snying rjes rang bde ring spangs nas// yengs med brtson pas chos sku'i ngang du 'byams// 'khrul pa'i snang ba nam yang mi mnga' ba// 'od gsal khor yug gyur la= /rdzogs pa che dang gsung ngag rin po che'i// dgongs nyams mthar phyin sangs rgyas zhing khams dang*// 'gro drug gnas rnams ma bsgribs sa ler gzigs// ye shes spyan dang ldan la= /gnyan khrod du mar lus srog thed la bor// stong nyid snying rje'i brtul zhugs rlabs chen gyis// rang snang dbang 'dus gzhan snang zil gyis mnan// spyod yul mthar phyin khyed la= /bla ma'i spyan sngar smon lam mdzad pa'i tshe// bka' brgyud bla ma byon nas byin gyis brlabs// snang sems sku dang zhing khams ye shes las// nam yang g.yo ba med la= /mthong thos dran reg gdul bya tshad med pa// thar pa'i grong du bkod nas ngo mtshar ltas// bsam mi khyab bcas bde ba can du gshegs// rnam 'phrul mkha' mnyam bstan la= /chos kyi rgyal po mkhas grub rin po che// dag pa'i zhing nas brtse bas gzigs mdzod la// 'gro kun srid pa'i mya ngan las bsgral zhing*// sgrub brgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i dge legs stsol/ ༈ /mkhas btsun 'jag chen rgyal mtshan 'bum la gsol ba 'debs pa rnam grol sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /smon lam rgya mtsho dri med gting mtha' bral// rmad byung yon tan rin chen gter gyis gang*// mkhas btsun sangs rgyas dpal ldan 'jag chen pa// rgyal mtshan 'bum pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// grub rigs thig ler sprul pa'i sku ru bstan// ma bslab yi ge rang (420)brdol blo rtsal rgyas// gzigs pa tsam gyis chos kun thugs la 'khrungs// gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul ston la=

/bslab gzhi kun blangs spang bya mtha' dag spangs// nges 'byung tshul khrims 'chal med pha rol son// thos pa'i bdud rtsi ngoms pa med par gsol// 'chad mkhas grags pas khyab la= /rgyun gcod mdzad tshe mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs// btung ba phal pa ro ldan bdud rtsir gyur// nag po chen pos zhal bstan bar chad bsal// rang bzhin rnal 'byor gyur la= /gtsang ma shangs ston chen pos rjes su bzung*// chos dang bka' lung mtha' dag rdzogs par stsal// nyams rtogs nges shes dbyar gyi ljongs ltar 'khrungs// rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin khyed la= /gnyan khrod du mar spyod yul mthar phyin mdzad// dben pa rnams su yengs med sgrub la brtson// bla ma yi dam rnams kyis zhal bstan cing*// ḍā ki'i lung bstan thob la= /'od gsal mdangs las 'khor 'das zhing kun gzigs// bla ma rin chen sna lnga'i dbang zhu dang*// dpe rnams stsal nas snyan brgyud bdag por bskos// 'gro don rjes su gnang la= /zhal mthong tsam gyis gzhan snang 'gyur ba dang*// dgongs pa gtad pas nad gdon mtha' dag zhi// chos 'dod tsam la ting 'dzin skyed par nus// snang sems dbang du mdzad la= /lan re yi dam lha yi sku ru bzhengs// skabs su dpa' bo ḍā kis zhabs tog sgrub// 'byung po che dgus 'dud cing ci bcol nyan// grub pa'i spyi rje khyod la= /rtsa gsum gnang ba ji bzhin gdams ngag rnams// yi ger bkod pas thub bstan ji srid bar// sgrub brgyud snying po rgyun mi chad mdzad pa// bka' drin bsam las 'das la= /skal ldan bye ba snyed kyi don mdzad nas// sku lus bkod pa du mas chos bstan sogs// bde ldan zhing du cho 'phrul chen pos gshegs// ring bsrel dpag med sprul la (421)gsol ba 'debs// rmu rgod bdag sogs snyigs mar chung ba rnams// mkhas btsun sangs rgyas chen pos byin rlobs la// rang sems chos sku mngon sum rtogs pa dang*// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/

/de nas 'jag bsam gnyis kyi gdan slob brgyud pa ni mtha' yas pas 'bri bar rdo mi thogs kyang rang lugs brgyud par shin tu gal che ba ni// khyung po tshul khrims mgon po la gsol ba 'debs pa pad+ma'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ spros bral mkha' la thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// byin rlabs 'od kyis skye dgu'i mun pa sel// ye shes snang ba skyed mdzad sprul pa'i sku// tshul khrims mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// skye 'gag gnas bral chos sku'i mkha' dbyings las// nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod sprin tu snang*// sna tshogs gang 'dul sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// mkha' khyab gdul bya 'dul la= /srid pa'i rtsa ba byang chub snying por bcad// zhing khams rgya mtshor rgyal ba'i phrin las kyis// yongs su khyab kyang khyad par dag pa'i zhing*// bde ba can du bzhugs la= /gzhan snang rgyal sras snying stobs chen po yi// ngang tshul bzung nas rgyal ba'i chos 'dzin cing*// zhing khams yongs sbyong 'gro mang smin pa sogs// rnam thar bsam mi khyab la= /rnyogs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten la// snying rje'i stobs can lhag par brtse bas na// mi mjed 'dzam gling byang phyogs bsil ldan du// bsam bzhin srid par rol la= /spang rtogs pha mthar son pas rang gi don// ched du bya ba rdul tsam ma dmigs kyang*// gdul bya thar pa'i lam du dkri ba'i phyir// bstan par rim 'jug mdzad la= /gsang gsum rdul bral gser gyi lhun po la// chos kyi bla gos thun mtshams dmar 'od 'khyud// lhag pa'i bslab pa nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ khams gsum mun pa sel la= /thos pa'i chu gter mkhyen rab nor bus gtams// rmad byung bsam pa'i rlabs phreng kun tu (422)g.yo// sgom pa rin chen ri dbang lhun mtho bas// gling bzhi'i rgyan du gyur la= /gtsang ma shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum pa'i zhabs// bsnyen pa'i tshul mdzad snyan brgyud bdud rtsis bcud// thugs su bskyil nas sgom pa'i ro myang bas// rtogs grol dus mnyam gyur la=

/sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis lung bstan cing*// grub pa rnal 'byor yongs kyi byin gyis brlabs// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje bo mdzad// gdul bzhi'i cho 'phrul ston la= /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing khams gzigs// de snyed rnams su rnam 'phrul mtha' yas spro// rang rang skad du chos sgo bsam yas ston// sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad la= /rgyal 'phags rnams dang bka' yi bgro ba mdzad// mchog grub rnams dang nyams kyi gleng mo 'chad// mkha' 'gro rnams dang gsang ba'i brtul zhugs spyod// ngo mtshar bsam mi khyab la= /mthong thos dran dang cha shas reg pa yang*// rnam grol gtan gyi bde bar dbugs dbyung stsal// mi min mi srun gdug pa'i sems zhi nas// byang sems myu gu bskrun la= /'phags bod mkhas btsun grub pa ma lus pa'i// rnam thar snying po gcig tu bsdus pa bzhin// 'jig rten gsum na 'gran gyi zla med pas// khyung po gsum par grags la= /skal ldan rnams la gsang ba'i mdzod khang stsal// bde ldan zhing du cho 'phrul chen pos gshegs// slar yang bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam rol gyis// gdul bya 'dul bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// bdag sogs skye dgu'i lus ngag yid gsum la// gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs rab zhugs te// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rnam thar sprin// chos dbyings kun khyab khyod dang mtshungs par shog/ ༈ /bya bral ri khrod ras chen la gsol ba 'debs pa gsang ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ (423)gangs dkar khrod du gdong lnga'i dbang po bzhin// bas mtha' dben pa'i gnas su ltos med bzhis// bsnyengs bral brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bya bral ba// ri khrod ras chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// snying po'i rigs mchog yongs su sad pa las// 'dir snang bde 'byor rmi lam rgyal srid la// chu shing lta bur snying po med gzigs nas// dal 'byor don yod mdzad la=

/'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du yang*// sdug bsngal rang bzhin sha btson khang bu ltar// ltar snang bde ba'ang sdug bsngal rgyur gzigs nas// nges 'byung khong nas brdol la= /lha mi'i dbang phyug mchog gi dpal 'byor yang*// mi rtag 'gyur ba glog gi gar mkhan bzhin// pha rol rjes 'brangs til tsam med gzigs nas// zhen log mtha' ru phyin la= /rnyed bkur grags sogs chos brgyad bslu brid rnams// srin mo'i gling bzhin thar pa'i srog gcod du// mkhyen nas rmi lam du yang dor mdzad pas// 'khor bar phyi phyag 'tshal la= /ched du bcos dang gzhan gyis bskul min par// mchog la dad gus dman la snying rje'i shugs// 'phel 'grib mi mnga' dus mtha'i me bzhin 'bar// rgyal sras sems dpa' chen por= /bshes gnyen bsten sogs chos bzhin bsgrub pa'i blo// pad+mo'i mtsho la ngang mo 'jug pa bzhin// skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs pas// dgongs spyod dri ma med la= /khyad par khyung po gsum pa'i zhabs pad+mo// mi phyed gus pas gtsug gi rgyan du bkod// mnyes pa rnam dgus zab gsang bcud nos te// rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin gyur la= /mchog gi can+ḍa lī yi gzi brjid 'bar// 'khor 'das chos kun sgyu ma'i lus su rtogs// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por snyoms par 'jug /nying 'khrul lha skur shar la= /'gyur med bde dang stong pa'i ros myos (424)te// snang srid zil gnon brtul zhugs gar brgya yis// 'khrul pa'i snang ba dbyings su bcil mdzad pas// skal ldan spro ba skyed la= /snyigs dus chos min rnam dpyod bdud ris kyi// sdong zlar bcas pas 'gro mang bslus gzigs nas// chos ltar bcos pa'i gzhan dbang ma shor bar// yang dag chos mthar phyin la= /dwangs ma'i sku la ras dkar bla gos 'khyud// do ha'i glu dbyangs dpal gyi mgur nas len// dgongs pa'i drod gtad las can shes rgyud du// rdo rje'i ye shes 'bebs la=

/rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs rje'i stobs skyed la// bdag blo chos min g.yang sa las sgrol te// srid la nges 'byung byang chub khang bzang du// chos kyi rgyal po'i dpal brnyes byin gyis rlobs/ ༈ /mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar po la gsol ba 'debs pa rnam dag sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /dri med mkhyen rab nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs// dmigs med brtse ba'i thugs rje gting mtha' bral// phrin las bsam mi khyab pa'i shangs dkar ba// rin chen rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rtag chad mtha' las rnam grol chos kyi dbyings// 'gyur ba med las thugs rje chen po'i rtsal// mos pa sna tshogs gzugs su rnam 'phrul bas// dus gsum gdul bya 'dul la= /sprin tshogs nam mkha'i klong du gcig pa bzhin// brgyud 'dzin gzugs sku'i rnam 'gyur du ma yang*// ye shes ḍā ki'i dbyings su ro gcig phyir// bsam bzhin srid pa bzung la= /mtho ris 'byor pa'i lang tshos mdzes pa'i sku// 'dam gyi khrod du skyes pa'i pad+ma bzhin// srid na srid pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pas// lhar bcas ngo mtshar skyed la= /rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa'i chu gter du// sbyor byung thos pa'i chu klung bye ba sdud// yon tan kun gzhi lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi// grong khyer nyams dgar 'dzegs la= /ris med tshad ma'i skyes bu'i zhabs bsten nas// gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i (425)bcud gsol khyad par du// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ri khrod ras chen las// don brgyud rtogs pa brnyes la= /rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa'i bcud zab mo// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig ma bslad pa// 'bras lam chos drug grol lam phyag rgya che// brtson pas nyams su bzhes la= /ro rkyang nyi zla'i bgrod pa kun 'dar mar// btsan thabs sbyor bas yongs su bcings nas su// ma dag las rlung zag pa'i grong khyer gyi// 'khrul 'khor bcom par mdzad la=

/zhu bde 'gyur ba med la brtan pa thob// snang grags rtog tshogs chu zla lta bur gzigs// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang skal mnyam gyur// bde chen ye shes brnyes la= /sprin bral mkha' la nyin byed dbang po bzhin// rnam dag sems la ye shes nyi ma shar// ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i snang ba rgyas// chos nyid bden pa gzigs la= /chu klung rgyun chad med par 'babs pa bzhin// brtan thob sems la mnyam rjes ris ma chad// bde gsal mi rtog 'phel grib med par myong*// nyams rtogs mtha' ru phyin la= /ri rgyal lhun po g.yo 'gul med pa bzhin// 'khrul rtog rkyen gyis nam yang g.yo ba med// gzhan tu mi tshol sangs rgyas rang las rnyed// 'bras bu mngon gyur khyed la= /rang don zung 'jug grub pa'i rgyal sar gshegs// gzhan don gang 'dul phrin las bsam yas kyis// skal dman tshar bcad skal ldan rjes su bzung*// bka' brgyud rgyal rabs spel la= /thar pa'i lam ston dge ba'i bshes dang mjal// lam mchog rdo rje theg pa'i gsang bar spyod// lam gyi mngon rtogs rtsol med rgyud la skyes// lam gsang mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ ༈

/mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs pa bdud rtsi'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa yongs kyi dpal du shar// khyad par bka' brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /(426)'gran zla kun bral mnyam med lkugs lung pa// sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dag pa'i sar gnas dbang chen thob pa yi// gzugs sku'i zla gzhon gdul bya'i chu snod du// rnam par gsal nas bstan dang 'gro don gyi// sgyu 'phrul ci yang ston la= /smon lam mthu can srid bde'i bslu brid kyis// mi g.yeng bzang po spyod pa chos nyid phyir// dpal 'byor mchil ma'i thal ba ring du btang*// gtan bde'i 'dun ma brtsams la= /chos min chos ltar bcos pas skye bo rnams// 'phral yun ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru sbyor gzigs nas// ston pa'i bstan pa yang dag snying po'i tshul// 'chug med btsal bar mdzad la= /'jigs skyob legs smon tsam min khams gsum las// nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims yid bzhin nor// lhag bsam byang sems rgyal mtshan rtser bkod pas// phan bde'i 'byung gnas gyur la= /shes pa'i don rtogs shes bya'i chos kun mkhyen// skye med don gzigs 'gag med brtse ba shar// nang gi lam bgrod phyi ru nus pa'i mthus// sna tshogs gdul bya 'dul la= /mkhas grub kun las mdo sngags gdams pa'i bcud// ngoms med bzhes kyang sngon 'brel bla ma'i mchog /mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar pos rjes bzung zhing*// las 'phro sad par mdzad la= /snyan brgyud nor bu'i mdzod chen rang nor bzhin// longs su spyad pas nyams dang rtogs pa'i dpyid// dbyar gyi sman ljongs lta bur rgyas pa yis// rin chen brgyud pa zin la= /ma dag rtsa yi mdud pa mtha' dag grol// gzung 'dzin rgyu ba dbu ma'i sbubs su thim// 'pho bcas thig le 'gyur med bde bar grub// grub ba'i spyi rjer gyur la=

/blos byas rtsol ba'i 'dzin stangs dbyings su yal// tha mal zhen pa'i 'khrul rtog rang sar dag /cir snang dag pa rab 'byams chen po'i ngang*// ye shes 'khor lor shar la= /kun rdzob las snang sgyu ma'i dpe ltar gzigs// (427)don dam chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur// zung 'jug bde chen ye shes gar gyis rol// brtan g.yo byin gyis brlabs la= /gang 'brel blo sna dam pa'i chos la sgyur// skal ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa la skyel// mi min gdug pa'i sems kyang zhi bar mdzad// snang ba dbang sgyur de la= /gsang ba'i brtul zhugs phyogs med grub pa yis// phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pa mthar phyin cing*// rdo rje'i lam nas mi slob zung 'jug gi /go 'phang mngon tu mdzad la= /phyi ru chos brgyad 'khrul pa'i rdzun phug zhig /nang du zhu bde 'gyur med 'od 'bar zhing*// gsang ba blo bral chos sku rjen par mthong*// mnyam med sangs rgyas rnam thar myur 'grub shog ༈ / khyung po tshul khrims mgon po nas 'di bar bla ma bzhi'i rnam thar zhib par ma mjal bas spyi bstod tsam du bgyis pa'o// rtogs ldan nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa zag med sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin// gangs can ljongs su bka' brgyud rin po che'i// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la mtshungs bral ba// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// spros pa'i 'ching grol sred len mtshams sbyor ni// gdod nas spangs kyang slob pa'i lam rnams su// thugs bskyed smon lam mthu las gzhan snang du// rnam 'phrul ci yang ston la= /mkhas grub skyes mchog du ma 'byung ba'i yul// sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+mas byin brlabs pa'i// gnas mchog khyad 'phags shangs phu'i dgon gsar du// bsam bzhin srid pa bzung la= /rnam dag rje'u'i rigs dang zhang gi rus// gzigs pas dgongs te lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe// ngo mtshar dge mtshan du mas yab yum gyi// lus sems byin gyis brlabs la=

/mdzes sku dpag bsam gsar pa'i myu gu la// skyes thob dge ba'i dri bsung ci yang 'phro// mtho ris 'byor (428)pa'i kho lag yongs rdzogs shing*// bslab gsum me tog 'dzum la= /dran dang shes bzhin rtag tu bag yod pas// bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i// nyes pa'i dri mas rdul tsam ma gos pas// btsun pa'i dpe ru gyur la= /nags kyi rin chen phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs// mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos bsnyen// mos gus sher brtson nyams bzhes nan chags kyis// kun gyi thugs sras gyur la= /theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhis bsdus pa'i// bka' dang bstan bcos tshig don thugs su chud// 'chad rtsod rtsom la mi 'jigs spobs pa brnyes// 'gran zla kun dang bral la= /grub brnyes sangs rgyas mtshan can thugs kyi bcud// rdzogs par bzhes nas dka' ba khyad bsad de// dben pa bsten pas bskyed dang rdzogs pa yi// ting 'dzin dbang thob gyur la= /bde drod rang 'bar byang sems 'dzag med brtan// snang ba bden med 'od gsal khor yug shar// rmi lam rtsal 'byongs dag pa'i zhing kun bgrod// spyan dang mngon shes mnga' la= /mnyam bzhag 'od gsal chos sku mngon tu gyur// rjes thob rtsol med snying rje'i nus pa yis// mi dang mi ma yin kun rgyud dul zhing*// snang ba dbang du sgyur la= /dus 'khor phag mo spyan gzigs zhi drag sogs// lhag pa'i lha zhal gzhan la ston nus shing*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sprin ltar 'du// ci bcol phrin las sgrub la= /zhal chab khrus chu'i zegs mas nad gdon 'byin// dgongs pa gtod pa tsam gyis bar chad sel// bya ba las kyi 'khor los sangs rgyas kyi// bstan pa dar rgyas mdzad la= /nyin gcig thos pas yid ches khong nas shar// rnal 'byor zla dus grub thob lo dus thebs// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i bshad sgrub kyi// snyan pas sa steng khyab la=

/mdo rgyud dgongs pa thogs med 'chad nus shing*// rim gnyis rtsal rdzogs (429)spyan dang mngon shes sogs// lung rtogs yon tan ldan pa'i bu slob ni// bgrang yas bskrun par mdzad la= /yar ngo'i tshes bcur dri bzang ngad 'thul zhing*// sgra 'od la sogs ngo mtshar ltas dang bcas// 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings su snyoms zhugs te// sprul pa'i sprin chen spro la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan bla ma gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i// mngon dga'i zhing skyes theg chen bdud rtsi myang*// mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba ma lus kun// zhing de'i gdul byar yongs su smin byed shog/ ༈ /mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs pa 'od gsal sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /nam mkha' bzhin tu phrin las rgya che zhing*// nyi zla lta bur grags pa rnam par gsal// rgya mtsho ji bzhin yon tan mtha' dang bral// rgyal ba mus pa chen por gsol ba 'debs// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro ba'i don tu 'phrul// gnyags rigs grub thob brgyud pa'i sras su 'khrungs// me tog char 'bebs sa gzhi rnam drug g.yos// 'jig rten mgon po khyed la= /khro phu sems dpa' chen pos byin rlabs shing*// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon 'gyur bar lung du bstan// gzhon nu nyid nas 'phags pa'i rnam thar gyis// 'gro kun dga' ba skyed la= /'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan la sogs pa// dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs// rig pa'i gnas dang sde snod rgyud man ngag /mi 'phrog spobs pa brnyes la= /mtha' gong dpal gyi gnas su sgrub la gzhol// rim gnyis byang chub sems la brtan pa thob// che ba'i yon tan snyan pa'i grags pa yis// nor 'dzin khyon kun khyab la= /hor gyi rgyal pos pho brang tā'i tur du// spyan drangs 'gro phan bsam las 'das par mdzad// chu dbar sprul pa'i gnas su dka' thub kyis// spangs rtogs mtha' ru phyin la=

/mkhas grub shangs ston spyan sngar byon pa'i tshe// mgon po'i lung bzhin gdams (430)ngag zab chos rnams// dgyes bzhin rdzogs par gnang bas grub pa yi// go 'phang mthon por gshegs la= /hor rgyal gan pa chen pos spyan drangs te// hor sog yu gur mi nyag la sogs pa'i// skad rigs mi gcig skye bo mtha' yas pa// thar pa'i gnas su bkod la= /lha dbang klu dbang mi dbang 'khor dang bcas// mkhas dang grub pa yongs kyis mgrin gcig brgyud// rkang gnyis gtso bo 'jig rten gsum po yi// gtsug gi nor bur gyur la=/ spyan ras gzigs sogs rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// mdun bdar snang mtha'i spyan sngar byon pa'i tshe// gangs can bde legs rdzogs ldan bzhin tu rgyas// thugs rje chen po khyed la= /gnyags ston chos rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos// mos pa'i bu la brtse bas rab dgongs te// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i sdug bsngal lus can rnams// rnam grol sa la bde blag 'god du gsol/ ༈ /mkhas grub rdo rje gzhon nu la gsol ba 'debs pa gnyug ma'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /dal 'byor rten la bslab gsum rgyan gyis spras// thos bsam sgom pa'i nor mchog zad mi shes// skal ldan gdul byar tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster// rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dbang po rab kyi rigs mchog yongs su sad// bshes gnyen mang bsten gzhung lugs du mar sbyangs// khyad par rgyal ba mus pa chen po yis// snyan brgyud bdag por bskos la= /bshul ring lam du 'phur ba'i tshul ltar bgrod// grang bas mi brdzi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin// bde drod rang 'bar mkha' la 'phar g.yo sgyur// thabs lam mthar thug 'byongs la= /sgyu ma rmi lam ting 'dzin mthar phyin cing*// spyan dang mngon par shes pa'i rnam thar 'chang*// lha mi'i dbang pos bcud kyang ltos pa bral// chos brgyad 'ching ba grol la= /nang gi yon tan blo yi ra ba las// 'das kyang phyi tshul sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// sgrub pa'i (431)rgyal mtshan g.yel ba med par btsugs// grub mchog chos kyi rje la=

/bgrang bya du mar bgres tshul mi mnga' bar// shin tu zo bdog bde zhing gzi mdangs gsal// dngas ma bzhi yi mnyen lcugs mchog ldan pa// 'chi med grub pa'i rje la= /ngo mtshar rmad byung skyes mchog rdo rje'i mtshan// byin rlabs thugs rje bdag sogs 'gro rgyud la// zhugs nas tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin cing*// grub pa mchog gi go 'phang la 'god shog ༈ /mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs pa zung 'jug sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /skyes mchog dag pa'i zhing du mngon sangs rgyas// rgyal sras rnams la theg chen chos sgra sgrog /ma dag zhing du sprul pas gzhan don mdzad// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'phags yul paṇa chen nyi ma'i snying po'i zhabs// thugs rje che dang phyag na rdo rje yis// byin rlabs grub pa yab yum lhums su 'phos// dge ba'i ltas bcas 'khrungs la= /byis pa'i tshul bstan mngon shes thogs med mnga'// 'jig rten bya ba kun la zhen pa log /dad dang shes rab snying rje'i rtsal rgyas shing*// thar pa'i rigs mchog sad la= /rgyal sras thogs med zhabs sogs dge ba'i bshes// du ma bsten nas rjod byed sde snod gsum// mkhas par sbyangs shing brjod bya bslab gsum gyis// thugs rgyud yongs su gtams la= /khyad par mus chen rje dang gzhon nu bar// nyams khrid gsan nas rtse gcig bsgoms pa yis// bde drod rab 'bar sgyu ma rang shar sogs// thabs lam yon tan rdzogs la= /nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par sgrub la brtson// zag med bsam gtan zas la longs su spyod// ting 'dzin sgo brgyar snyoms par 'jug cing ldang*// tshogs chen bla med spel la= /bde gshegs yi dam mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung*// chags thog spangs pa'i mngon shes spyan dang ldan// (432)bar do'i 'gro ba mtha' dag rab gzigs nas// rnam kun thugs rjes 'dzin la= /nad pa rnams la sman pa'i rgyal po bzhin// 'jigs pas nyen rnams dran pa tsam gyis skyob// byang chub sems kyi phrin las mtha' yas pas// skye dgu'i mgon tu gyur la=

/mthong thos dran reg phyir mi ldog la bkod// skye 'chi'i mtshan ma spangs kyang gdul bya'i ngor// sangs rgyas zhing khams mang por dus gcig tu// gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan la= /dad ldan don tu ring bsrel dpag med sprul// lha mi kun gyis srid mtha'i bar du mchod// ngo mtshar mtshan ma rgyun chad mi mnga' ba// byin rlabs bsam las 'das la= /rje btsun mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pas// gsol 'debs bu la thugs rje'i rtsal sprugs te// dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ ༈ /grub chen thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa grub pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /thugs rje che dang dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal// dbyer med gcig bsdus mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// snyigs 'gro'i skyabs su sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul ston// thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen dol po pa// gdul dka' 'dul phyir grub pa'i skur bzhengs pa// ye shes ḍā ki yongs kyi ming gcig po// mtshan mchog lnga dang ldan la= /la stod byang du rdo rje'i mtshan dpe gsal// 'phags pas bskul te khyim spangs rab tu byung*// dbu skra bsil tshe 'ja' 'od me tog khengs// brtson 'grus bzang po'i zhabs la= /gzhung lugs sbyong tshe ting 'dzin ngang du 'byams// ma bslab par yang chos kun thugs su chud// thog ma nyid nas rdzu 'phrul dpag med bstan// rang byung grub pa chen por gsol= /sangs rgyas byang sems rnal 'byor pho mo dang*// dge sbyong rigs ngan ku su lu pa'i tshul// yang dag bla ma lnga brgya phrag gcig las// chos sgo tshad med gsan la= /thar pa gling du thugs dam mdzad pa'i tshe// rdo rje 'chang chen rigs lnga (433)sems dpa' brgyad// khro bcu lha mo'i tshogs bcas dngos su mjal// lam zab la sogs zab chos du ma gsan// sgrib gnyis mun pa bral la=

/thugs rje phyogs med shes bya thams cad mkhyen// rang snang dbang sgyur las bzhir mnga' dbang brnyes// rtogs pas rgyud grol brtul zhugs mtha' ru phyin// chos brgyad zil gyis mnan la= /gnas chen rnams su smon lam du ma mdzad// sngon byon grub thob yi dam lha tshogs mjal// dur khrod rnams su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// tshogs kyi 'du bar rol la= /kha ba can pa'i mi dang mi ma yin// gcan gzan nad pa 'on long nyam thag sogs// khyod sku mthong thos dran pas gnas skabs su// 'jigs pa kun zhi mthar thug mngon mtho dang*// nges legs thob cing theg chen dam chos dar// khyad par mtha' 'khob kla klo thul cig ces// spyan ras gzigs dang rje btsun sgrol ma yis// yang yang gsung gis bskul la= /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos sgo mtha' yas stsal// yan lag 'byung las shes rab phar phyin gsan// he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma dpal gyis// dbang bskur rgyud rnams gtad la= /dur khrod chen po keng rus me 'bar du// dpal chen bi rū pa yis rjes su bzung*// lam 'bras yongs rdzogs dam rdzas bdud rtsi gnang*// zag pa rgyun chad gyur la= /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu lan gsum du// byon nas dbang dang gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang*// rdzu 'phrul mngon shes bsam mi khyab par 'khrungs// gdams ngag yi ger bkod la gsol ba 'debs// zangs gling yul du grub chen sha ba ris// ngo sprad byin brlabs rdo la me 'bar du// bram ze mchog sred zhabs kyis nag po che// srung mar dngos su gtad la= /srin yul zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo'i rtser// bla ma sku gsum khyad par o rgyan rjes// sgrub chen brgyad sogs dbang chos mtha' yas pa// gnang nas lung bstan mdzad la= /rdo rje sems dpas a ti yo ga stsal// mkha' 'gros bskul te bod kyi gdul byar gzigs// (434)kla klo'i yul byon rdzu 'phrul tshad med pas// btul nas chos su bkod la=

/rgya bal kha che li dang o rgyan yul// rgya hor zla ba nas gling ka liṅga// pri yaṅku sogs dzam gling gling phran bcas// mtha' dag rdzu 'phrul chen po'i zhabs kyis gcags// skal bar ldan rnams dngos su grol bar mdzad// gzhan dag ma 'ongs pa na rang nyid kyi// gdul byar smin phyir thabs mkhas sna tshogs pas// sa steng chos kyis bkang la= /snod ldan rgan gzhon med pa mkha' spyod bkod// gcan gzan rnams kyang gus pas zhabs tog sgrub// lha srin sde brgyad btul nas dam la bzhag /'byung zhir rang dbang sgyur la= /chu klung du ma lcags kyi zam pas sbrel// mthong grol bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten dang*// rin chen gar lugs sku brnyan du ma sogs// rten gsum dpag yas bzhengs la= /mtha' dmag kha gnon sa yi me btsa' gdab// 'byung bzhi'i gnyen por rten mchog kun tu bkod// smon lam mdzad pas nad dang mu ge yi// 'jigs las yun ring bskyabs la= /sman gyi bla mas bdud rtsi 'chi sos dang*// tshe dpag med kyi tshe yi ril bu gnang*// 'gro ba mtha' dag nad gdon dus min gyi// 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog la= /'tha' 'khob ka ma ta ru sku lus kyi// bkod pa bstan tshe sdig spyod rgyal blon gyis// mes bsregs chu yis ma tshugs de dag kun// dad cing chos su bkod la= /mchog gi bu drug nye ba'i sras mchog brgyad// ye shes ḍā ki lnga dang sbas tshul gyi// mkha' 'gro bcu drug dam tshig ḍā ki nī// bco brgyad rig 'dzin pho mo sum cu bdun// las can nga brgyad mi ldog lnga brgya phrag /gzhan don nus pa bye ba khri brgyad sogs// smin grol mdzad nas gdams ngag skabs brgyad bsdus// rgyal tshab mnga' gsol mdzad la= /sku dngos bgrang bya brgya dang nyer brgyad mthar// cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bzhir 'od phung du// nam mkhar gshegs tshe thugs sras gdung dbyangs kyis// mdun mkhar gzugs skur bstan la=

/slar yang gsol ba btab tshe khru gang sku// sgrub pa'i (435)gnas byon 'od gsal zhag bdun bzhugs// ngo mtshar gdung rten lha mi'i mchod yul du// g.yo med brtan par bzhugs la= /slad nas gdul bya skal ldan rnams kyi ngor// nye ring gang du'ang byon nas byin gyis brlabs// bod yul bde ba'i phrin las rgyun chad med// bka' drin bsam las 'das la= /spyan ras gzigs dbang grub chen chos kyi rje// khyed kyi thugs rje skyo dub ma mchis pas// bdag sogs skal med dus mthar skyes pa la// zhal ston byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// grub mchog khyed kyi sku tshe gdul bya'i zhing*// rnam thar smon lam mdzad stobs ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag gis myur 'grub ste// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro kun sgrol byed shog/ ༈

/rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa lhan skyes sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ ye shes mkha' la gnyug ma'i gar stabs sgyur// mi shigs 'od gsal bde ba'i gzi mdangs 'bar// grub pa mchog gi phyag byas rgya sgom pa// legs pa rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi btson ra bzhin tu bor// nges legs bstan la rnam dag tshangs par spyod// sngon sbyangs las 'phro dkar po'i chos la sad// skyes bu chen po'i zhabs la= /mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i dge ba'i bshes// mang du bstan nas mdo sngags chos spyi dang*// bye brag dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi// ring lugs rdzogs par gsan la= /grub dbang nam mkha'i mtshan gyis rjes su bzung*// sgrub la brtson pa nyin mtshan g.yel med mdzad// nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas// rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyod la= /byang chub sems mchog gnyis la khyod kyi thugs// rtag tu gzhol bas nyi tshe'i phrin las la// ma bkol bar yang tshar gcod rjes 'dzin sogs// ye shes mgon pos sgrub la= /bkod pa lus kyi sprul bsgyur la sogs pa// rnam thar bsam mi khyab la mnga' mdzad kyang*// rtag tu tha mal brtul zhugs lhur mdzad pa// sbas pa'i sangs rgyas khyed la= /(436)'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo rgyal tshab tu// mnga' chen gsol bas bka' brgyud grub pa'i klung*// thub bstan ji srid mi nyams 'babs pa yi// phrin las rmad du byung la= /gzhan don dgongs tshe gdung gi cha shas las// sprul pa'i ring bsrel zad med 'phel bas kyang*// skal ldan du ma thar pa'i gnas su bkod// mdzad pa mthar phyin khyed la= /gsol btab dge bas bdag sogs 'gro rgyud kyi// sgrib gnyis dri ma gtan nas byang ba dang*// lhan skyes 'od gsal gnyug ma chos sku'i zhal// gcer mthong sku gsum rang shar nyid gyur cig/ ༈ /rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa smin grol sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/

rgyal bas lung bstan spyod 'chang grub pa'i dbang*// gangs can snying po'i bstan pa spel ba'i phyir// 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo'i skur bstan pa// kun dga' grol mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sprul pa'i zla zhal glo bo smon thang du// 'char tshe skabs gsum grong nas 'ong 'dra ba'i// pad+ma'i sdong po kha dog dri bsungs can// dpyid kyi dpal bzhin bzhad la= /mtshan dpe'i me tog 'byung 'khrugs reg pa yis// gtses pa'i tshe na thub bstan nyi gzhon dang*// 'grogs pa'i mod la gegs kyi g.yul las rgyal// chos don ngang gis 'byor la= /yul dbus rig grol gnyis ldan pad+mo'i mtshor// ldog med ngang pa bzhin tu dga' bas zhugs// na tshod phra yang snying stobs spyod pa sbom// sems kyi mdud grol mchog la= /sngon sbyangs stobs sad sde snod rtsol med mkhyen// dbyangs can mgrin par zhugs pa'i brjod pa sogs// mkhas tshul gsum gyi rnam dpyod dar babs pas// blo gsal yid dbang 'phrog la= /gtsug rgyan nor bus lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad// rin chen rnam bzhis gdams pa'i gnad rnams gnang*// paṇa chen gnyis kyis the tshom drwa ba bsal// bzhed dgongs lhun gyis grub la= /bya btang gnyis kyis (437)rtogs pa'i bogs 'don mdzad// dag gi dbang pos tha snyad spro ba bskyed// khyad par rdo rje 'chang dngos rgya sgom rjes// thugs kyi bang mdzod gtad la gsol ba 'debs// phyi tshul dri med so thar bslab pas bsdams// nang du byang chub sems la rang dbang 'byor// gsang ba sngags kyi brtul zhugs 'chang rnams kyi// 'khor los sgyur ba mchog la= /gsang bdag gshin rje gshed pos bar chad bsal// dgyes mdzad yab yum 'khor lo sdom pa dang*// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs lhag pa'i lhas// byin brlabs rjes su bzung la= /mkha' spyod dbang phyug rje btsun ni gu mas// chos drug ye shes mgon po la sogs pa// stsal bas 'od gsal mtha' dbus med par rtogs// ngo mtshar nye brgyud thob la=
