/so sa gling du mkha' 'gro chen mo dang*// tshogs kyi 'du bar spyod cing byang chub tu// lung bstan mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i rtogs pa spel// mkha' 'gros bu bzhin skyong la= /mi tra rdzo gis snying po don gsum gnad// legs ldan 'byed kyis brda yi chos dbang bskur// stobs 'phrog dbang po rnam thos sras la sogs// chos skyong bran du khol la= /gang snang sgyu ma'i rnam rol du shar nas// 'dzin med rang shar ma bcos zhen bral blos// ma chags bu chud spyod pa'i ngang tshul gyis// byas tshad chos su 'gro la= /mthong thos dran reg ngan 'gro'i gnas spong ba'i// 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i skyes bu zhes// bslu med rdo rje'i gsung gis zhal 'ches pa// skye dgu'i mgon por gyur la= /gangs can gdams pa'i chu klung mtha' dag bsdus// ni gu'i khrid srol brgya phrag lhag pas mtshon// gzhan phan nam mkha'i mthar khyab spel mdzad nas// mkha' spyod grong du gshegs la= /slar yang 'phags bod o rgyan 'gro lding sogs// ma nges gnas su gang la gang 'dul gyi// sprul pa du mas gdul bya'i zhing sbyangs nas// bla med byang chub brnyes pa= /skye kun grub pa'i dpa' bos rjes bzung ste// (438)gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// rab 'byams rnam thar rgya mtsho'i sprin bkod pa// rje btsun khyed dang mtshungs par mdzad du gsol/ ༈ /chos sku lha dbang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs pa zab mo'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan khyab bdag 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku// gzhom med sgra dbyangs brjod bral rdo rje'i gsung*// bde chen zung 'jug mnyam nyid rdo rje'i thugs// lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sh+lo ka 'di rje btsun rin po che'i gsung ngo*/ /rdo rje'i lus la skyon bral lang tshos brgyan// zab lam yon tan kun skyed dpal gyis 'byor// brtul zhugs spyod la bsnyengs pa med pa'i blo// skyes thob rtsal chen rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje'i rigs mchog thog ma nyid nas sad// gnyis 'dzin blang dor bral yang ltar snang gi*// 'khor ba sgyu ma lta bur nges 'byung gis// blo sna chos su bskul la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje'i slob dpon sems kyi mdud grol mchog

/gtsug tu bsnyen nas mnyes pa rnam gsum bsgrubs// gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs yongs rdzogs thob// dam pa'i thugs zin gyur la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje theg pa'i yang bcud rim gnyis la// 'bad rtsol chen pos sgrub pa mtha' ru bskyal// sgom byung stobs las mkhyen rab chags thogs med// spyan dang mngon shes mnga' la gsol ba 'debs// mos gus stobs kyis cir snang bla mar gzigs// gtum mo mthar phyin bde drod me ltar 'bar// sgyu lus dbang thob sna tshogs sprul bsgyur nus// dag snang rab tu 'byams la gsol ba 'debs// gzung 'dzin rlung sems a ba dhū tir thim// 'khor 'das ma lus chos sku rjen par shar// re dogs snyems 'phrig spang blang rdul tsam med// bya btang rgyal po khyed la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje'i ye shes che la dbang 'byor pas// skal ldan rnams la byin rlabs dngos su 'bebs// rtogs pa'i stobs kyis gzhan snang zil gyis (439)gnon// rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed la gsol ba 'debs// nyin snang sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur gzigs// mtshan snang rnam dag 'od gsal chen por 'byams// kun kyang zung 'jug bde chen thig ler shar// nyams rtogs mtha' ru phyin la gsol ba 'debs// ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs// pho nya gsum 'dus tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyod// zol med grub pa chen po'i rgyal thabs bskyang*// rje btsun brag stod pa la gsol ba 'debs// rnam grol bdud rtsi bgo bshar stsal ba yis// grub pa'i rgyal srid skyong ba'i nye dbang tshogs// sgrol ba'i mgon gyur rje btsun lha yi dbang*// mnga' gsol don chen mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// ngo mtshar bka' brgyud gser gyi phreng ba bzung*// byin rlabs chu rgyun mi zad gter gyur pas// shangs pa'i bstan la bya ba rlabs chen mdzad// 'gran bral skyes mchog khyed la gsol ba 'debs// 'khrul med dam pa bsten cing byin rlabs zhugs// gsang ba'i lam mchog mthar phyin dngos grub thob// zab mo'i ring lugs rgyun mi chad spel ba// khyod kyi rnam thar 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/

/'dir jo nang rje btsun rin po che'i gsol 'debs zhal gsungs kha 'gengs bcas sbyar ro/ ༈ /rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma karma gzhan phan 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs pa dge legs sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam thar 'chang*// tha mal snang ngor sbas pa'i brtul zhugs can// 'brel tshad don ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog /gzhan phan 'od zer zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zhen log nges 'byung bcos min nang nas brdol// shākya'i bstan la rnam dag tshangs par spyod// rje btsun smra ba'i seng ges byin brlabs pas// 'bri klog rang brdol mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs// ma bsgrubs par yang dmar nag me phreng can// zhal bstan phyi nang bar du gcod pa bsal// mtshan ldan yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhal (440)sgo 'grims// chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes la gsol ba 'debs// dbon ston dngos byon sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa// karma lhag mthong zhabs las shangs chos sogs// gdams ngag bcud gsol rje btsun rmog lcogs pa'i// rnam rol zhal gyis bzhes la gsol ba 'debs// blo sbyong mdzad tshe lo gsum shig nad kyis// gtses kyang stong nyid snying rje'i dbyings su dengs// dka' spyad brtson 'grus bsam gyis mi khyab pas// gdams ngag nyams bzhes mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// gtum mo sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal gyi// ting 'dzin mthar thug brnyes pas rlung sbyor gyis// nad gdon dngos su 'don sogs phyi yi rtags// bsnyon med mngon sum ston la gsol ba 'debs// chos brgyad dri ma rmi lam du yang spangs// ngo srung mthun 'jug nam yang mi mnga' zhing*// 'dir ltos bya bzhag slogs rul bzhin tu dor// bya btang rgyal po khyed la gsol ba 'debs// thogs bcas thogs med ya nga skyugs bro la// bdag 'dzin blos btang ro snyoms zlog sgom gyis// thugs dam bogs thon brtul zhugs rtsal chen rdzogs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyod la gsol ba 'debs// nyams dang rtogs pa bsam mi khyab pa 'khrungs// grub pa lha dang mkha' 'gros zhal bstan cing*// chos srung dam can tshogs kyis phrin las sgrub// gong ma'i brgyud pa zin la gsol ba 'debs// mi snang la sogs sprul bsgyur cho 'phrul mnga'// 'byung 'gyur gnas sogs lkog gyur dngos su mkhyen// dag pa'i snang ngor mar pa lo tsā sogs// sprul pa'i gzugs su ston la gsol ba 'debs// ma nges thod rgal spyod pa sna tshogs pas// rkyen snang gang byung thad ka'i lam du gcod// snang sems dbang du 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor pa// karma ma ṇi'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// skal ldan gdul bya rnams la sgrub (441)brgyud spel// bzang ngan 'brel tshad phyir mi ldog pa yi// phrin las mthar phyin 'od gsal chen por bzhugs// ye shes sku mchog khyod la gsol ba 'debs// dran mchog dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// snying gi ze'u 'bru tshangs pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus/

thugs rje g.yel ba med par rtag bzhugs la// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ༈ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la gsol ba 'debs pa bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ ji lta ji snyed shes bya thams cad mkhyen// dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro la bu ltar dgongs// 'khor ba dong sprugs nus pa'i chos kyi rgyal// mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs// gang 'dul rnam rol chos dbyings khyab pa las// snyigs dus bstan 'gro skyobs pa'i dpal mgon tu// bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes la gsol ba 'debs// mdo smad sde bzhi dge bcu'i sman gyi ljongs// phrin las 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i gnas kyi char// rnam dag rigs sogs mchog gi gzigs pa lngas// sprul pa'i sku ru bstan la gsol ba 'debs// ye shes brnyes pa'i rnam 'dren mchog rnams kyis// dam pa'i skyes bur mgrin gcig lung bstan cing*// phal pa'i spyod las 'das phyir lha mi kun// 'gro ba'i mgon tu bsngags la gsol ba 'debs// dbus gtsang bod chen kun tu zhabs kyis gcags// mnyes pa gsum gyis yongs 'dzin brgya lhag bsten// skyo ngal med par dam chos yongs su tshol// thugs bskyed dpag yas khyod la gsol ba 'debs// sa chen phug tu thugs dam mdzad pa'i tshe// lhag pa'i lha yi phyag rgya thugs kar thim// spobs pa'i gter chen brgyad po yongs su grol// mkhyen gnyis rtsal chen rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs// sgra tshad bzo gso grangs (442)gnas tshig rgyan sogs// gnas lnga rig pa yan lag dang bcas par// phul du son pas gangs can 'dzin ma'i khongs// mkhas pa'i snyan pas khyab la gsol ba 'debs// 'dul mngon dbu ma phar phyin gsang sngags kyi// rgyud kun gzigs pa tsam gyis gting slebs cing*// mi brjed gzungs thob brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i tshul// ma sbas gsal bar ston la gsol ba 'debs// dri med tshul khrims nor bu'i rgyan chas sgeg

/ting 'dzin 'dzum dkar skal ldan yid dbang 'gugs// shes rab rol sgegs sa gsum dpyid du g.yo// bslab gsum dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zab rgyas gnas la chos spyan rdul dang bral// 'chad rtsod rtsom la chags dang thogs pa med// mdzad spyod kun la 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad// lha mi yid ches skyed la gsol ba 'debs// rang gi yon tan rgya mtsho gter bzhin sbed// gzhan gyi yon tan phra mor bsngags shing 'dud// bstan 'gro'i don du gces dgu'i bdog pa yang*// rtswa bzhin gtong bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// gzungs dang ting 'dzin mngon shes rgya mtsho mnga'// 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod 'os nyid gyur kyang*// khengs dregs mi mnga' dam chos tshig gcig phyir// dka' chen dang du bzhes la gsol ba 'debs// ltar snang chos la bsnyad pa'i 'dzin skyong sogs// 'jig rten bya bzhag gang la'ang ltos med pas// 'jig med seng ge lta bur kun bzang spyod// sa steng 'gran zla bral la gsol ba 'debs// sgrub brgyud shing rta che brgyad ring lugs kyi// gzhung gdams man ngag chu klung ma lus pa// thugs mtshor bskyil nas smin grol rgyud 'bebs pas// bstan pa'i srog rtsa mthud la gsol ba 'debs// thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i shing rta che// gdul bya ris su ma chad 'dul ba'i gnyen// phyogs su ma lhung grub mtha' mtha' dag gi /gtsug gi nor bur gyur la gsol ba (443)'debs// phrin las thams cad gzhan phan 'ba' zhig sgrub// 'brel tshad don ldan ngo mtshar ltas mang mnga'// bsod nams tshogs chen bsam mi khyab pa bskrun// sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan yab yum dri med bshes gnyen zhabs// chos rgyal mes dbon chos dbang kun mkhyen sogs// dgu ldan brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lhas// byin brlabs dngos grub stsal la gsol ba 'debs/

kha /khyad par slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis// mdo rgyud gsang mdzad stsal nas ye shes skur// byin gyis brlabs pas nyid dang dbyer med pa'i// mkhyen rtogs rdzogs par sad la gsol ba 'debs/ ka /brtse ba chen po khu dbon brgyud bcas kyis// dbang bskur rgyud gtad gzhan yang 'phags bod kyi// mkhas grub du mas dngos nyams rmi lam du// yang yang rjes su bzung la gsol ba 'debs// 'dus pa'i dal du zhugs tshe so ston mchog /ye dbang mthu yis snyigs ma'i phung khams sbyangs// rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang ba gsum du gyur// rigs kun khyab bdag mchog la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal yum rdo rje btsun mos rjes su bzung*// snang srid dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lor shar// rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar gzigs// grub pa'i khyu mchog khyod la gsol ba 'debs// phyi nang gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba thob// 'bar ba gsum gyi ye shes gong du 'phel// spyod pa gsum gyi rten 'brel mthar phyin pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen por gsol ba 'debs// skyes rabs du ma'i las kyi 'phro sad de// mdo rgyud bka' lung dkon pa'i bu sta ka /rten mchog dam rdzas chu klung bye ba snyed// rnam thar rgya mtshor bskyil la gsol ba 'debs// brgyud pa drug ldan sa dang dgongs pa'i gter// dag snang snyan brgyud rjes dran yang gter bcas// bka' babs rin chen rnam bdun rgyal srid brnyes// chos kyi 'khor los rgyur la gsol ba 'debs// rang snang dbang 'dus gzhan snang zil gyis mnan// ma 'bad par yang phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub// ḍā ki chos (444)srung mthu ldan dregs pa yis// ci bcol bka' bzhin sgrub la gsol ba 'debs// zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo grangs med pas// skal ldan bye snyed smin cing grol bar mdzad// bsam gyis mi khyab 'phags pa'i rnam thar 'chang*// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyed la gsol ba 'debs// mi phyed gus pas rtse gcig gsol btab mthus// skye ba 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar// dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral bar// rjes su bzung nas rnam thar mngon byed shog

/mnyes pa gsum gyis tshul bzhin bsten nas kyang*// thugs kyi bcud thob nyams len mtha' ru phyin// sa dang lam gyi yon tan yongs rdzogs te// rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang 'grub gyur cig /chos bzhin sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// lung rtogs chos la rang la dbang thob yis// thub dbang bstan pa 'dzam gling kun tu spel// chos kyi rgyal po khyed dang mtshungs par shog/ ༈ /dpal ldan bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa kun tu bzang po'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /karma bka' brgyud bstan pa'i snang byed mchog /ngag gi dbang phyug yon tan rgya che'i mtsho// dge legs phrin las rlabs phreng kun tu khyab// dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// tshar gcod rjes 'dzin kun shes yan lag bcas// bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la thos bsam dang*// sgom pa'i blo gros chags thogs bral ba yi// rnam dpyod mtha' yas ldan la gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma dbang chen sogs kyis rjes su bzung*// gar gyi dbang phyug thugs rje'i rig sngags 'chang*// phrin las 'gro ba 'dul ba'i rtsal mnga' ba// dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// grub rigs 'dzin pa khyung gi gdung las grol// sbyangs pa'i las 'phro dkar po'i chos la sad// 'khor lo gnyis kyi mthun rkyen ngang gis tshogs// ngo mtshar rmad du byung la gsol ba 'debs// gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong bas rgyud bsdams shing*// gzhan phan gzhir bcas bslab pa'i gnas la gzhol// rim gnyis mngon rtogs ci yang gsal ba yi// sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs// mkhas grub ded dpon yongs 'dzin du ma bsten// mdo sngags rgya mtshor lhag bsam (445)brtson pas zhugs// gzhung gdams man ngag nor bu'i skyes bzang gis// skal ldan dbul ba sel la gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rdo rje'i bkas// gter 'byin grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur rnams kyis// rnam snang bai ro tsa na'i rnam 'phrul du// lung bstan mnga' gsol mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba yab sras mchog gling mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// mchog gzigs rnams kyis tā ra nā tha dang*// 'gyur med rdo rje'i sprul par zhal bzhes shing*// yongs 'dzin mchog tu bkur la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bstan ris med skyong ba'i dag snang dang*// 'gro phan ris med sgrub pa'i lhag bsam ste// gang byung thad kar khyer ba'i spyod tshul gyis// dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi dben gnas su// tshe gcig sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs nas su// 'chad rtsom bka' babs bstan la bya ba mdzad// don gnyis lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar bsngags pa'i don// he ru ka yi sku gsung thugs kyi rten// bstan pa ji srid bar du 'gro phan gyi// btsas su bsgrubs par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// mos pa'i stobs dang rten 'brel bslu med mthus// dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*// mkha' spyod grong khyer chen por lhan cig 'tshogs// rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas mchog thob gyur cig

/gang gi gsang gsum rdo rje ltar brtan cing*// zab rgyas chos rnga rtag tu sgrogs pa yis// bdag sogs legs pa'i lam kun mthar phyin cing*// bsam don lhun grub dge legs dpal 'bar shog bsngags 'os kyi yon tan cha shas phra mos kyang ma gos shing rang nyid la bstod pa ma rabs blun po'i lugs su gyur kyang*/ sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa pad+ma nor bus nan tan chen pos bskul ngo ma ldog tsam (446) du 'du gsum pa yon tan rgya mtshos sug bris su bstar ba dge legs 'phel/ ༈ /de dag thams cad kyi gzhug tu spyir smon lam bya ba don kun grub pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma rnams// dmigs med thugs rje chen pos 'dir gshegs la// mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs// dad ldan mos pa'i bu la rjes su dgongs// bdag sogs 'gro kun zhing rdul grags snyed kyi// sgo gsum gus pas btud de phyag bgyi'o// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs kyis// rnam pa kun tu bstod cing gsol ba 'debs// lus dang longs spyod dngos 'byor yid las byung*// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung rgya mtshos mchod// thog med nas bsags bcas dang rang bzhin gyi// sdig sgrib nyes ltung 'gyod pas bshags zhing bsdam// 'khor 'das kun gyi zag bcas zag med kyi// dge ba kun la snying nas rjes yi rang*// dbang por 'tshams pa'i theg gsum chos 'khor ni// 'gro khams ji srid bar du bskor bar bskul// dmigs med thugs rje rgyun chad med pa'i ngang*// gzugs sku rdo rje lta bur rtag brtan gsol// 'dis mtshon dus gsum legs spyad ci mchis pa// bdag dang pha ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las myur du 'grub phyir bsngo// bla ma rnams kyis thugs rjes rjes su bzung*// ma gus log lta skad cig mi 'byung zhing*// zhabs tog dgu phrugs sgo nas mnyes pa gsum// mthar phyin thugs yid gcig tu 'dre bar shog

/tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun khyed rnams dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba ma mchis par// ci mdzad legs mthong ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin// bla ma'i gsang ba gsum dang dbyer (447)med shog /snying nas dad cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar ci mchis pa// thams cad bdag nyid kho nas 'grub gyur cig /so skye'i tshig gi mgal dur la// byin rlabs gzi brjid ldan min kyang*// mos pa kho nas sbyar ba'i dges// bla ma rnams dang dbyer med shog /bdag rgyud yon tan mi ldan kyang*// mtshan ldan bla mas rjes bzung bas// bka' brgyud 'di 'dra'i byin rlabs thob// bstan 'gror phan 'dod lhag bsam mnga'// skal bzang 'du shes gsum pa'i sde// ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho yis// tsā 'dra rin chen brag mgul du// rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus// sgra dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho yi// gsol 'debs rgyud mangs sgrengs pa 'di// sa gsum skye dgu'i rna ba ru// 'babs nas dbyangs su len par shog /dge legs 'phel/// /(448)
